title: Sentence Puzzle
description: Word-order practice sentences for Nova: lash-client talk, blackjack dealer table English, and daily life in the US.

levels.name: Short sentences
levels.guide: Short subject-verb-object sentences and simple requests.

levels.name: Time and place
levels.guide: Adverbs and the usual English order for time and place.

levels.name: Negatives
levels.guide: Negative sentences with don't, isn't, can't, and similar forms.

levels.name: Prepositions
levels.guide: Sentences built around prepositions such as on, at, in, for, and off.

levels.name: Longer sentences
levels.guide: Longer sentences with if, when, until, before, and in case.

usage.check: A guess is correct if it exactly matches tiles or any array in accepted.

sentences.english: The following footage was posted by Vanessa Berlin, who had caught something disturbing on her doorbell camera.
sentences.chinese: 下面这段视频是 Vanessa Berlin 发布的，她的门铃摄像头拍到了一些让人不安的东西。
sentences.sourceTitle: 01 Doorbell Face · 门铃摄像头里的脸

sentences.english: Vanessa writes, "I grew up in a haunted home with paranormal investigators and priests constantly coming to my house, so I don't get that scared easily.
sentences.chinese: Vanessa 写道：“我是在一栋闹鬼的房子里长大的，灵异调查员和神父总来我家，所以我没那么容易被吓到。
sentences.sourceTitle: 01 Doorbell Face · 门铃摄像头里的脸

sentences.english: But last night, I saw this through my Ring camera at 11:30 PM, and it was the only time that I truly felt scared."
sentences.chinese: 但昨晚 11 点半，我在 Ring 门铃摄像头里看到了这个，那是我唯一一次真正感到害怕。”
sentences.sourceTitle: 01 Doorbell Face · 门铃摄像头里的脸

sentences.english: This is what she'd seen.
sentences.chinese: 这就是她看到的画面。
sentences.sourceTitle: 01 Doorbell Face · 门铃摄像头里的脸

sentences.english: Be sure to look closely, or you'll miss it.

sentences.sourceTitle: 01 Doorbell Face · 门铃摄像头里的脸

sentences.english: A faint image of what appears to be a face can be seen hiding behind the flowers.
sentences.chinese: 花丛后面隐约能看到一个像是人脸的影像。
sentences.sourceTitle: 01 Doorbell Face · 门铃摄像头里的脸

sentences.english: It's hard to make out what this is, but it seems like someone, or something, is looking at the doorbell camera.

sentences.sourceTitle: 01 Doorbell Face · 门铃摄像头里的脸

sentences.english: But as always, I'll let you decide as to what this might be.

sentences.sourceTitle: 03 Hazel Is Growling · 狗狗 Hazel 一直在低吼

sentences.english: If there are spirits here, I rebuke you in the name of Jesus Christ.
sentences.chinese: 如果这里有灵体，我奉耶稣基督的名斥责你。
sentences.sourceTitle: 03 Hazel Is Growling · 狗狗 Hazel 一直在低吼

sentences.english: You must leave. You're not welcome here.
sentences.chinese: 你必须离开，这里不欢迎你。
sentences.sourceTitle: 03 Hazel Is Growling · 狗狗 Hazel 一直在低吼

sentences.english: What is Hazel seeing, and what might be the reason as to why she's growling?
sentences.chinese: Hazel 看到了什么？她为什么会低吼？
sentences.sourceTitle: 03 Hazel Is Growling · 狗狗 Hazel 一直在低吼

sentences.english: It's believed that dogs can see things, such as entities, that we can't.
sentences.chinese: 人们相信，狗能看到一些我们看不见的东西，比如某些“存在”。
sentences.sourceTitle: 03 Hazel Is Growling · 狗狗 Hazel 一直在低吼

sentences.english: But I'll let you decide as to whether or not she's actually seeing something.
sentences.chinese: 但她是否真的看到了什么，由你来判断。
sentences.sourceTitle: 03 Hazel Is Growling · 狗狗 Hazel 一直在低吼

sentences.english: As always, feel free to let me know what you think.
sentences.chinese: 和往常一样，欢迎告诉我你的看法。
sentences.sourceTitle: 03 Hazel Is Growling · 狗狗 Hazel 一直在低吼

sentences.english: A garment factory in Japan has been experiencing strange activity.
sentences.chinese: 日本的一家服装厂一直在发生怪事。
sentences.sourceTitle: 04 Miss Tanaka's Factory · 服装厂里的田中女士

sentences.english: It was just recently that the factory's surveillance cameras had caught footage of the strange things that have been happening.
sentences.chinese: 就在最近，工厂的监控摄像头拍下了这些怪事的画面。
sentences.sourceTitle: 04 Miss Tanaka's Factory · 服装厂里的田中女士

sentences.english: When the owner of the factory had seen the footage, he was shocked.
sentences.chinese: 工厂老板看到这段录像时，非常震惊。
sentences.sourceTitle: 04 Miss Tanaka's Factory · 服装厂里的田中女士

sentences.english: But he wasn't shocked for the reason you're probably thinking.
sentences.chinese: 但他震惊的原因，可能和你想的不一样。
sentences.sourceTitle: 04 Miss Tanaka's Factory · 服装厂里的田中女士

sentences.english: The factory owner himself best explains the footage that was captured.
sentences.chinese: 拍到的画面，还是由工厂老板本人来解释最清楚。
sentences.sourceTitle: 04 Miss Tanaka's Factory · 服装厂里的田中女士

sentences.english: Take a look.
sentences.chinese: 来看看吧。
sentences.sourceTitle: 04 Miss Tanaka's Factory · 服装厂里的田中女士

sentences.english: The factory owner believes that if the ghost of Miss Tanaka is behind all these strange occurrences, then it isn't necessarily bad.
sentences.chinese: 工厂老板认为，如果这些怪事背后真是田中女士的鬼魂，那也不一定是坏事。
sentences.sourceTitle: 04 Miss Tanaka's Factory · 服装厂里的田中女士

sentences.english: After all, Miss Tanaka seems to be truly missed by her coworkers.
sentences.chinese: 毕竟，同事们似乎真的很想念田中女士。
sentences.sourceTitle: 04 Miss Tanaka's Factory · 服装厂里的田中女士

sentences.english: These strange occurrences are probably the closest thing to having Miss Tanaka around one more time.
sentences.chinese: 这些怪事，大概是最接近“田中女士再回来一次”的方式了。
sentences.sourceTitle: 04 Miss Tanaka's Factory · 服装厂里的田中女士

sentences.english: The following segment features a set of videos of strange occurrences that have taken place inside a home.
sentences.chinese: 下面这一段是一组视频，记录了发生在一户人家里的怪事。
sentences.sourceTitle: 05 The Laundry Room · 洗衣房里的怪事

sentences.english: Very little information is given on these videos, but each one speaks for itself.
sentences.chinese: 关于这些视频的信息很少，但每一段都不言自明。
sentences.sourceTitle: 05 The Laundry Room · 洗衣房里的怪事

sentences.english: Each video was shot in a room where most of the activity takes place.
sentences.chinese: 每段视频都是在怪事最多的那个房间里拍的。
sentences.sourceTitle: 05 The Laundry Room · 洗衣房里的怪事

sentences.english: It is for this reason that a camera was placed inside to capture these strange occurrences.
sentences.chinese: 正因如此，他们才在房间里放了一台摄像机来拍下这些怪事。
sentences.sourceTitle: 05 The Laundry Room · 洗衣房里的怪事

sentences.english: However, it seems that with each occurrence, the activity gets worse.
sentences.chinese: 然而，怪事似乎一次比一次严重。
sentences.sourceTitle: 05 The Laundry Room · 洗衣房里的怪事

sentences.english: Out of all incidents, the fifth occurrence is probably the creepiest.
sentences.chinese: 在所有事件中，第五次大概是最吓人的。
sentences.sourceTitle: 05 The Laundry Room · 洗衣房里的怪事

sentences.english: This is what was captured.
sentences.chinese: 这就是拍到的画面。
sentences.sourceTitle: 05 The Laundry Room · 洗衣房里的怪事

sentences.english: It's the last occurrence that's hard to explain.
sentences.chinese: 最难解释的是最后一次。
sentences.sourceTitle: 05 The Laundry Room · 洗衣房里的怪事

sentences.english: Somehow, the garment in the basket appears to throw itself into the washer.
sentences.chinese: 不知怎么的，篮子里的衣服好像自己跳进了洗衣机。
sentences.sourceTitle: 05 The Laundry Room · 洗衣房里的怪事

sentences.english: It could be that the video is playing in reverse, making it seem as though it threw itself in when it actually fell into the basket.
sentences.chinese: 也可能是视频在倒放，所以看起来像是衣服自己跳进去，其实是掉进了篮子里。
sentences.sourceTitle: 05 The Laundry Room · 洗衣房里的怪事

sentences.english: But even if the video wasn't reversed, it doesn't explain how the laundry fell into the basket on its own.
sentences.chinese: 但就算视频没有倒放，也解释不了衣服是怎么自己掉进篮子里的。
sentences.sourceTitle: 05 The Laundry Room · 洗衣房里的怪事

sentences.english: Viewers can't seem to explain this final clip, but what do you think?
sentences.chinese: 观众们似乎也解释不了最后这一段，你怎么看？
sentences.sourceTitle: 05 The Laundry Room · 洗衣房里的怪事

sentences.english: Had a poltergeist been caught on camera, or was this something else?
sentences.chinese: 是镜头拍到了恶作剧鬼，还是另有原因？
sentences.sourceTitle: 05 The Laundry Room · 洗衣房里的怪事

sentences.english: General Shim is resting on his rooftop when he sees something that leaves him terrified.
sentences.chinese: General Shim 正在自家屋顶上休息，这时他看到了一样让他吓坏了的东西。
sentences.sourceTitle: 06 Rooftop Watcher · 屋顶上的“人”

sentences.english: General Shim writes, "I just wanted to loiter on my house's rooftop because the breeze there is soothing and fresh, but little did I know that someone else would be there with me."
sentences.chinese: General Shim 写道：“我只是想在屋顶上待一会儿，因为那里的风清新又舒服，没想到还有‘别人’和我在一起。”
sentences.sourceTitle: 06 Rooftop Watcher · 屋顶上的“人”

sentences.english: This is what he saw.
sentences.chinese: 这就是他看到的。
sentences.sourceTitle: 06 Rooftop Watcher · 屋顶上的“人”

sentences.english: General Shim hopes that this was just a coconut on a tree, but what do you see?
sentences.chinese: General Shim 希望那只是树上的一个椰子，但你看到的是什么？
sentences.sourceTitle: 06 Rooftop Watcher · 屋顶上的“人”

sentences.english: Could this be a case of pareidolia, or an actual sinister-looking entity?
sentences.chinese: 这是“空想性错视”（把东西看成人脸），还是真有一个阴森的东西？
sentences.sourceTitle: 06 Rooftop Watcher · 屋顶上的“人”

sentences.english: A family buys a doll from a thrift store, but ever since buying it, there's been nothing but strange occurrences taking place inside their home.
sentences.chinese: 一家人从二手店买了一个玩偶，可自从买回来，家里就怪事不断。
sentences.sourceTitle: 07 The Thrift Store Doll · 二手店买来的玩偶

sentences.english: They believe that the doll is haunted and is therefore responsible for the strange activity that's been happening.
sentences.chinese: 他们认为这个玩偶闹鬼，所以家里的怪事都是它造成的。
sentences.sourceTitle: 07 The Thrift Store Doll · 二手店买来的玩偶

sentences.english: From toys turning on by themselves to things moving on their own, the family is stuck in a house that they believe is haunted.
sentences.chinese: 从玩具自己启动，到东西自己移动，这家人被困在一栋他们认为闹鬼的房子里。
sentences.sourceTitle: 07 The Thrift Store Doll · 二手店买来的玩偶

sentences.english: The family has no idea as to how they could stop the strange activity.
sentences.chinese: 这家人完全不知道该怎么让这些怪事停下来。
sentences.sourceTitle: 07 The Thrift Store Doll · 二手店买来的玩偶

sentences.english: But then one day, a friend of the family suggested that they light a white candle by the doll in the hopes that doing so would stop the activity.
sentences.chinese: 后来有一天，一位朋友建议他们在玩偶旁边点一支白蜡烛，希望这样能让怪事停止。
sentences.sourceTitle: 07 The Thrift Store Doll · 二手店买来的玩偶

sentences.english: They do just that, but something very strange happens.
sentences.chinese: 他们照做了，结果发生了一件非常奇怪的事。
sentences.sourceTitle: 07 The Thrift Store Doll · 二手店买来的玩偶

sentences.english: The family sets up a camera in front of the doll to capture anything unusual that happens.
sentences.chinese: 他们在玩偶前面架了一台摄像机，想拍下任何不寻常的事。
sentences.sourceTitle: 07 The Thrift Store Doll · 二手店买来的玩偶

sentences.english: This is what they caught.
sentences.chinese: 这就是他们拍到的。
sentences.sourceTitle: 07 The Thrift Store Doll · 二手店买来的玩偶

sentences.english: The candlelight mysteriously gets brighter, but unfortunately, this had no effect on the strange activity.
sentences.chinese: 烛光莫名其妙地变亮了，可惜这对怪事毫无作用。
sentences.sourceTitle: 07 The Thrift Store Doll · 二手店买来的玩偶

sentences.english: Things only appear to get worse.
sentences.chinese: 情况似乎只变得更糟。
sentences.sourceTitle: 07 The Thrift Store Doll · 二手店买来的玩偶

sentences.english: But then one day, the strangest incident happens.
sentences.chinese: 后来有一天，发生了最诡异的一件事。
sentences.sourceTitle: 07 The Thrift Store Doll · 二手店买来的玩偶

sentences.english: The daughter is playing with the doll when the following is caught on camera.
sentences.chinese: 女儿正在玩那个玩偶，镜头拍下了下面的画面。
sentences.sourceTitle: 07 The Thrift Store Doll · 二手店买来的玩偶

sentences.english: If you listen closely, you can almost hear what sounds like a slap.
sentences.chinese: 仔细听的话，几乎能听到像是一记耳光的声音。
sentences.sourceTitle: 07 The Thrift Store Doll · 二手店买来的玩偶

sentences.english: The daughter even says that she was hurt.
sentences.chinese: 女儿甚至说她被打疼了。
sentences.sourceTitle: 07 The Thrift Store Doll · 二手店买来的玩偶

sentences.english: But what do you think?
sentences.chinese: 你怎么看？
sentences.sourceTitle: 07 The Thrift Store Doll · 二手店买来的玩偶

sentences.english: Did the doll actually slap her, or was it something else?
sentences.chinese: 真是玩偶打了她，还是另有原因？
sentences.sourceTitle: 07 The Thrift Store Doll · 二手店买来的玩偶

sentences.english: Amar Kate posted the following video and writes, "We should have listened to the dog and the knocking downstairs."
sentences.chinese: Amar Kate 发布了下面这段视频，并写道：“我们早该听狗狗的，也该在意楼下的敲门声。”
sentences.sourceTitle: 08 Listen to the Dog · 应该听狗狗的

sentences.english: This is what they caught on camera.
sentences.chinese: 这就是他们拍到的画面。
sentences.sourceTitle: 08 Listen to the Dog · 应该听狗狗的

sentences.english: All right, come on. We're gonna have to go and check.
sentences.chinese: 好了，走吧。我们得下去看看。
sentences.sourceTitle: 08 Listen to the Dog · 应该听狗狗的

sentences.english: Leave him up here. Come on.
sentences.chinese: 把它留在上面。走吧。
sentences.sourceTitle: 08 Listen to the Dog · 应该听狗狗的

sentences.english: My shoes are upstairs.
sentences.chinese: 我的鞋在楼上。
sentences.sourceTitle: 08 Listen to the Dog · 应该听狗狗的

sentences.english: Forget the keys. It's probably best to just leave.
sentences.chinese: 别管钥匙了，最好直接离开。
sentences.sourceTitle: 08 Listen to the Dog · 应该听狗狗的

sentences.english: And of course, don't forget the dog.
sentences.chinese: 当然，别忘了带上狗。
sentences.sourceTitle: 08 Listen to the Dog · 应该听狗狗的

sentences.english: Two friends are inside a room recording someone who appears to be yelling at something.
sentences.chinese: 两个朋友在一个房间里，正在拍一个好像在对着什么东西大喊的人。
sentences.sourceTitle: 09 The Shadow Figure · 小小的黑影

sentences.english: It isn't until they decide to approach this person that they see what it is that they're yelling at.
sentences.chinese: 直到他们走近这个人，才看清他在对着什么喊。
sentences.sourceTitle: 09 The Shadow Figure · 小小的黑影

sentences.english: What they saw left them more disturbed than before.
sentences.chinese: 他们看到的东西让他们比之前更加不安。
sentences.sourceTitle: 09 The Shadow Figure · 小小的黑影

sentences.english: This is what they caught.
sentences.chinese: 这就是他们拍到的。
sentences.sourceTitle: 09 The Shadow Figure · 小小的黑影

sentences.english: There appears to be a small, shadowy figure manifesting and disappearing at the same time.
sentences.chinese: 画面里似乎有一个小小的黑影，忽隐忽现。
sentences.sourceTitle: 09 The Shadow Figure · 小小的黑影

sentences.english: I'll leave it to you to decide as to whether or not this was something paranormal.
sentences.chinese: 这是不是灵异现象，就交给你来判断。
sentences.sourceTitle: 09 The Shadow Figure · 小小的黑影

sentences.english: As always, what are your thoughts?
sentences.chinese: 和往常一样，你怎么想？
sentences.sourceTitle: 09 The Shadow Figure · 小小的黑影

sentences.english: A security camera records a child who's inside a crib when something downright creepy is captured.
sentences.chinese: 一台监控摄像头拍着婴儿床里的孩子，结果拍下了非常诡异的一幕。
sentences.sourceTitle: 10 The Baby in the Crib · 婴儿床里的孩子

sentences.english: The child's mother had posted the following video, as she doesn't know what to make of it.
sentences.chinese: 孩子的妈妈发布了下面这段视频，因为她也不知道该怎么解释。
sentences.sourceTitle: 10 The Baby in the Crib · 婴儿床里的孩子

sentences.english: She was in the same room as her son when, out of nowhere, he began to cry.
sentences.chinese: 她和儿子在同一个房间里，孩子突然毫无征兆地哭了起来。
sentences.sourceTitle: 10 The Baby in the Crib · 婴儿床里的孩子

sentences.english: It wasn't until watching the footage that she was left disturbed.
sentences.chinese: 直到看了录像，她才感到不安。
sentences.sourceTitle: 10 The Baby in the Crib · 婴儿床里的孩子

sentences.english: The mother writes, "I'm still trying to figure out if the camera glitched or something pushed my baby."
sentences.chinese: 妈妈写道：“我还在想，到底是摄像头卡了，还是有什么东西推了我的宝宝。”
sentences.sourceTitle: 10 The Baby in the Crib · 婴儿床里的孩子

sentences.english: This is what was caught.
sentences.chinese: 这就是拍到的画面。
sentences.sourceTitle: 10 The Baby in the Crib · 婴儿床里的孩子

sentences.english: The child all of a sudden disappears from the camera's view.
sentences.chinese: 孩子突然从镜头里消失了。
sentences.sourceTitle: 10 The Baby in the Crib · 婴儿床里的孩子

sentences.english: It appears that he was pushed over forcefully.
sentences.chinese: 看起来他是被用力推倒的。
sentences.sourceTitle: 10 The Baby in the Crib · 婴儿床里的孩子

sentences.english: The question is, though, what exactly had pushed him over?
sentences.chinese: 但问题是，到底是什么推倒了他？
sentences.sourceTitle: 10 The Baby in the Crib · 婴儿床里的孩子

sentences.english: The cradle in the back continues to swing as the child vanishes from the frame, suggesting that this wasn't a glitch.
sentences.chinese: 孩子从画面中消失时，后面的摇篮还在继续摆动，说明这不是画面卡顿。
sentences.sourceTitle: 10 The Baby in the Crib · 婴儿床里的孩子

sentences.english: If it was, then the swing would have skipped a frame, just like the child had.
sentences.chinese: 如果是卡顿，摇篮也会像孩子一样跳掉一帧。
sentences.sourceTitle: 10 The Baby in the Crib · 婴儿床里的孩子

sentences.english: But as you can see, not a single frame is skipped.
sentences.chinese: 但正如你看到的，一帧都没有跳。
sentences.sourceTitle: 10 The Baby in the Crib · 婴儿床里的孩子

sentences.english: So then, if this wasn't a glitch, then what was it?
sentences.chinese: 那么，如果不是卡顿，那又是什么？
sentences.sourceTitle: 10 The Baby in the Crib · 婴儿床里的孩子

sentences.english: No one else is seen in the room except the mother and child, and nothing appears to have pushed him over.
sentences.chinese: 房间里除了妈妈和孩子，没有别人，也看不到有什么东西推了他。
sentences.sourceTitle: 10 The Baby in the Crib · 婴儿床里的孩子

sentences.english: As with all videos, it's up to you to decide if this is something paranormal or not.
sentences.chinese: 和所有视频一样，是不是灵异现象，由你来决定。
sentences.sourceTitle: 10 The Baby in the Crib · 婴儿床里的孩子

sentences.english: The child's mother has yet to figure that out.
sentences.chinese: 孩子的妈妈到现在也没弄明白。
sentences.sourceTitle: 10 The Baby in the Crib · 婴儿床里的孩子

sentences.english: But as always, feel free to share what you think.
sentences.chinese: 和往常一样，欢迎分享你的看法。
sentences.sourceTitle: 10 The Baby in the Crib · 婴儿床里的孩子

sentences.english: Chucho Gutierrez is a nurse who works at a hospital in Veracruz, a city in Mexico.
sentences.chinese: Chucho Gutierrez 是一名护士，在墨西哥韦拉克鲁斯市的一家医院工作。
sentences.sourceTitle: 11 The Hospital Hallway · 医院走廊里的孩子

sentences.english: It's three in the morning, and Chucho is filming his colleagues, who are currently on break.
sentences.chinese: 凌晨三点，Chucho 正在拍正在休息的同事们。
sentences.sourceTitle: 11 The Hospital Hallway · 医院走廊里的孩子

sentences.english: But as he records them, something disturbing is seen in the background.
sentences.chinese: 可就在他拍的时候，背景里出现了让人不安的东西。
sentences.sourceTitle: 11 The Hospital Hallway · 医院走廊里的孩子

sentences.english: A child is seen walking down the hall, but there's something off about this child.
sentences.chinese: 一个孩子正沿着走廊走过去，但这个孩子有点不对劲。
sentences.sourceTitle: 11 The Hospital Hallway · 医院走廊里的孩子

sentences.english: Moments later, it reappears, but this time, crawling on all fours.
sentences.chinese: 过了一会儿它又出现了，但这次是四肢着地爬行。
sentences.sourceTitle: 11 The Hospital Hallway · 医院走廊里的孩子

sentences.english: Perhaps this might have been a patient of the hospital who passed away.
sentences.chinese: 这也许是医院里一位去世的病人。
sentences.sourceTitle: 11 The Hospital Hallway · 医院走廊里的孩子

sentences.english: A spiritual cleanse might help with getting rid of those who've died but whose presence still lingers.
sentences.chinese: 做一次“灵性净化”，也许能帮忙送走那些已经去世、却还在徘徊的存在。
sentences.sourceTitle: 11 The Hospital Hallway · 医院走廊里的孩子

sentences.english: Ashley Rayne and her fiancé are away from home when their security camera inside their apartment captures something disturbing.
sentences.chinese: Ashley Rayne 和未婚夫不在家时，公寓里的监控摄像头拍到了让人不安的东西。
sentences.sourceTitle: 12 Peeking at the Cat · 偷看猫咪的东西

sentences.english: Ashley writes, "We were moving out of our apartment and caught this on our camera.
sentences.chinese: Ashley 写道：“我们正在搬出公寓，结果摄像头拍到了这个。
sentences.sourceTitle: 12 Peeking at the Cat · 偷看猫咪的东西

sentences.english: My cat won't take its eyes off of it."
sentences.chinese: 我的猫一直盯着它看，眼睛都不眨。”
sentences.sourceTitle: 12 Peeking at the Cat · 偷看猫咪的东西

sentences.english: This is what she caught.
sentences.chinese: 这就是她拍到的。
sentences.sourceTitle: 12 Peeking at the Cat · 偷看猫咪的东西

sentences.english: There appears to be someone or something peeking at the cat from behind the doorway.
sentences.chinese: 好像有人——或者某种东西——躲在门框后面偷看那只猫。
sentences.sourceTitle: 12 Peeking at the Cat · 偷看猫咪的东西

sentences.english: But it does so in a very strange manner.
sentences.chinese: 但它偷看的方式非常奇怪。
sentences.sourceTitle: 12 Peeking at the Cat · 偷看猫咪的东西

sentences.english: It seems to be peeking sideways, with its hands gripping the doorway's frame on one side.
sentences.chinese: 它好像是侧着身子偷看，双手抓着门框的一边。
sentences.sourceTitle: 12 Peeking at the Cat · 偷看猫咪的东西

sentences.english: But as if that wasn't creepy enough, it seems to ascend and then disappear.
sentences.chinese: 好像这还不够吓人，它似乎还往上升，然后消失了。
sentences.sourceTitle: 12 Peeking at the Cat · 偷看猫咪的东西

sentences.english: Both Ashley and her fiancé have no clue as to what this could have been.
sentences.chinese: Ashley 和未婚夫都完全不知道那会是什么。
sentences.sourceTitle: 12 Peeking at the Cat · 偷看猫咪的东西

sentences.english: Now, this could be someone who had broken into their apartment, but there's something odd about this person, and what they do seems physically impossible for anyone to do.
sentences.chinese: 这可能是闯进他们公寓的人，但这个“人”有点怪，它的动作似乎是任何人都不可能做到的。
sentences.sourceTitle: 12 Peeking at the Cat · 偷看猫咪的东西

sentences.english: It's a good thing Ashley is moving out, as I doubt she'd want to stay there after seeing this.
sentences.chinese: 还好 Ashley 要搬走了，我想看到这个之后，她也不会想再住下去了。
sentences.sourceTitle: 12 Peeking at the Cat · 偷看猫咪的东西

sentences.english: Morales Debbie and her friends are tubing through a canal when they capture something creepy on camera.
sentences.chinese: Morales Debbie 和朋友们坐着游泳圈在运河里漂流时，镜头拍到了诡异的东西。
sentences.sourceTitle: 13 Tubing Through the Canal · 运河漂流

sentences.english: The video was taken on July 8th of 2018, but prior to this date, about five years ago, someone had drowned in the same canal that Morales is in.
sentences.chinese: 视频拍摄于 2018 年 7 月 8 日，而大约五年前，就在 Morales 所在的这条运河里，有人溺水身亡。
sentences.sourceTitle: 13 Tubing Through the Canal · 运河漂流

sentences.english: Little does she know that she and her friends would capture something disturbing.
sentences.chinese: 她完全没想到，她和朋友们会拍到让人不安的东西。
sentences.sourceTitle: 13 Tubing Through the Canal · 运河漂流

sentences.english: Take a look.
sentences.chinese: 来看看吧。
sentences.sourceTitle: 13 Tubing Through the Canal · 运河漂流

sentences.english: It was only after posting the video on Facebook and being told by viewers about this that she noticed.
sentences.chinese: 直到把视频发到 Facebook、观众告诉她之后，她才注意到。
sentences.sourceTitle: 13 Tubing Through the Canal · 运河漂流

sentences.english: Viewers think that this might have been the ghost of the victim who had drowned.
sentences.chinese: 观众认为，这可能是那位溺水者的鬼魂。
sentences.sourceTitle: 13 Tubing Through the Canal · 运河漂流

sentences.english: Others think that this could have been something else, perhaps a creature.
sentences.chinese: 也有人认为可能是别的东西，也许是某种生物。
sentences.sourceTitle: 13 Tubing Through the Canal · 运河漂流

sentences.english: No one knows for sure, but it seems like more people believe that this might be the spirit of the deceased.
sentences.chinese: 没人能确定，但似乎更多人相信那是死者的灵魂。
sentences.sourceTitle: 13 Tubing Through the Canal · 运河漂流

sentences.english: But of course, what are your thoughts?
sentences.chinese: 当然，你怎么想呢？
sentences.sourceTitle: 13 Tubing Through the Canal · 运河漂流

sentences.english: Ghost or not?
sentences.chinese: 是鬼还是不是？
sentences.sourceTitle: 13 Tubing Through the Canal · 运河漂流

sentences.english: "My friend Audrey told me her daughter had a friend she played with, thinking just an imaginary friend.
sentences.chinese: “我的朋友 Audrey 跟我说，她女儿有个一起玩的朋友，她以为只是想象出来的朋友。
sentences.sourceTitle: 14 The Imaginary Friend · 看不见的朋友

sentences.english: Audrey couldn't believe how fast her daughter's room would get messy right after cleaning it.
sentences.chinese: Audrey 不敢相信，女儿的房间刚收拾好就那么快又变乱了。
sentences.sourceTitle: 14 The Imaginary Friend · 看不见的朋友

sentences.english: So as her daughter was in the room talking to herself, Audrey decided to take a photo.
sentences.chinese: 所以趁女儿在房间里自言自语时，Audrey 决定拍张照片。
sentences.sourceTitle: 14 The Imaginary Friend · 看不见的朋友

sentences.english: Later that night, Audrey was skimming through the photos, and this is what was in the photo."
sentences.chinese: 那天晚上，Audrey 翻看照片时，照片里出现了这个。”
sentences.sourceTitle: 14 The Imaginary Friend · 看不见的朋友

sentences.english: Audrey also adds that if you look closely, there appears to be a floating head by the closet doorway.
sentences.chinese: Audrey 还补充说，仔细看的话，衣柜门口好像有一颗飘浮的头。
sentences.sourceTitle: 14 The Imaginary Friend · 看不见的朋友

sentences.english: Now, I know some people are against this, but maybe using a Ouija board might help in finding out if your child is playing with a ghost.
sentences.chinese: 我知道有些人反对这么做，但也许用通灵板能帮你弄清楚孩子是不是在和鬼玩。
sentences.sourceTitle: 14 The Imaginary Friend · 看不见的朋友

sentences.english: But it's probably best to seek help elsewhere, as reaching out to the dead seems like a bad idea.
sentences.chinese: 不过最好还是找别的办法求助，因为和死者联系似乎不是个好主意。
sentences.sourceTitle: 14 The Imaginary Friend · 看不见的朋友

sentences.english: Bailey B works at an old theater that is said to be haunted.
sentences.chinese: Bailey B 在一家据说闹鬼的老剧院工作。
sentences.sourceTitle: 15 The Haunted Theater · 闹鬼的剧院

sentences.english: Although Bailey loves his job, there's something about it he wishes he could change.
sentences.chinese: 虽然 Bailey 很喜欢这份工作，但有一点他希望能改变。
sentences.sourceTitle: 15 The Haunted Theater · 闹鬼的剧院

sentences.english: He often works at night, and he doesn't like this.
sentences.chinese: 他经常上夜班，而他不喜欢这样。
sentences.sourceTitle: 15 The Haunted Theater · 闹鬼的剧院

sentences.english: For some reason, whenever Bailey's on stage, he can't help but feel like there's someone there.
sentences.chinese: 不知为什么，每当 Bailey 站在舞台上，他总忍不住觉得那里还有别人。
sentences.sourceTitle: 15 The Haunted Theater · 闹鬼的剧院

sentences.english: It almost feels like there's someone watching him.
sentences.chinese: 几乎就像有人在看着他。
sentences.sourceTitle: 15 The Haunted Theater · 闹鬼的剧院

sentences.english: It's for this reason that he often records while working.
sentences.chinese: 正因如此，他工作时经常开着录像。
sentences.sourceTitle: 15 The Haunted Theater · 闹鬼的剧院

sentences.english: But then one night, Bailey receives a notification that a sensor has detected motion inside the theater.
sentences.chinese: 可有一天晚上，Bailey 收到通知：剧院里的传感器检测到了动静。
sentences.sourceTitle: 15 The Haunted Theater · 闹鬼的剧院

sentences.english: Bailey writes, "This is the scariest thing that has ever happened to me.
sentences.chinese: Bailey 写道：“这是我遇到过的最可怕的事。
sentences.sourceTitle: 15 The Haunted Theater · 闹鬼的剧院

sentences.english: I might quit."
sentences.chinese: 我可能要辞职了。”
sentences.sourceTitle: 15 The Haunted Theater · 闹鬼的剧院

sentences.english: This is what he captured.
sentences.chinese: 这就是他拍到的。
sentences.sourceTitle: 15 The Haunted Theater · 闹鬼的剧院

sentences.english: It's, uh, 9 p.m. on a Saturday. This is my life.
sentences.chinese: 现在是，呃，周六晚上 9 点。这就是我的生活。
sentences.sourceTitle: 15 The Haunted Theater · 闹鬼的剧院

sentences.english: So I'm walking through the main stage here.
sentences.chinese: 我现在正走过主舞台。
sentences.sourceTitle: 15 The Haunted Theater · 闹鬼的剧院

sentences.english: Ghost light is on.
sentences.chinese: “幽灵灯”亮着。
sentences.sourceTitle: 15 The Haunted Theater · 闹鬼的剧院

sentences.english: No one in here. Hello? Okay.
sentences.chinese: 这里没人。有人吗？好吧。
sentences.sourceTitle: 15 The Haunted Theater · 闹鬼的剧院

sentences.english: Bailey was in total shock and was trying to process what he'd seen.
sentences.chinese: Bailey 完全惊呆了，努力想弄明白自己看到了什么。
sentences.sourceTitle: 15 The Haunted Theater · 闹鬼的剧院

sentences.english: Now, it could be that someone had broken in and decided to seat themselves on the balcony.
sentences.chinese: 当然，也可能是有人闯了进来，坐到了楼座上。
sentences.sourceTitle: 15 The Haunted Theater · 闹鬼的剧院

sentences.english: But given the history of this place, which has had numerous paranormal occurrences, Bailey can't shake the thought of this being a ghostly encounter.
sentences.chinese: 但考虑到这里的历史——发生过许多灵异事件——Bailey 怎么也甩不掉“这是撞鬼了”的念头。
sentences.sourceTitle: 15 The Haunted Theater · 闹鬼的剧院

sentences.english: But if anything, Bailey can rest assured that he isn't losing his mind, as what he captured on camera shows that someone or something was actually watching him.
sentences.chinese: 但至少 Bailey 可以放心，他没有疯，因为他拍到的画面显示，确实有人或某种东西在看着他。
sentences.sourceTitle: 15 The Haunted Theater · 闹鬼的剧院

sentences.english: The following video was submitted by Maria, who had caught her dog acting very strange.
sentences.chinese: 下面这段视频是 Maria 投稿的，她拍到自家狗狗的举动非常奇怪。
sentences.sourceTitle: 16 Maria's Scared Dog · Maria 发抖的狗

sentences.english: Maria writes, "It's been several days that my dog's been acting strange.
sentences.chinese: Maria 写道：“这几天我的狗一直很反常。
sentences.sourceTitle: 16 Maria's Scared Dog · Maria 发抖的狗

sentences.english: She doesn't want to go to her bed, and she seems so scared, to the point she starts shaking.
sentences.chinese: 她不肯去自己的窝，而且看起来非常害怕，怕到浑身发抖。
sentences.sourceTitle: 16 Maria's Scared Dog · Maria 发抖的狗

sentences.english: So tonight, I decided to record her, and this is what I captured."
sentences.chinese: 所以今晚我决定把她录下来，这就是我拍到的。”
sentences.sourceTitle: 16 Maria's Scared Dog · Maria 发抖的狗

sentences.english: For some reason, Maria's dog can't help but shake whenever she's near a specific room in the house.
sentences.chinese: 不知为什么，Maria 的狗一靠近家里某个特定的房间，就忍不住发抖。
sentences.sourceTitle: 16 Maria's Scared Dog · Maria 发抖的狗

sentences.english: Now, it's obvious that her dog is shaking out of fear, but the real question is why.
sentences.chinese: 很明显，狗狗是因为害怕才发抖的，但真正的问题是：为什么？
sentences.sourceTitle: 16 Maria's Scared Dog · Maria 发抖的狗

sentences.english: What might be the reason as to why she's behaving like this?
sentences.chinese: 她这样表现，可能是什么原因呢？
sentences.sourceTitle: 16 Maria's Scared Dog · Maria 发抖的狗

sentences.english: Maria believes that a ghost might be responsible for her dog's strange behavior.
sentences.chinese: Maria 认为，狗狗的反常行为可能是鬼魂造成的。
sentences.sourceTitle: 16 Maria's Scared Dog · Maria 发抖的狗

sentences.english: Given the belief that some pets can see things humans can't, could it be that she's actually seeing something?
sentences.chinese: 既然人们相信有些宠物能看到人看不到的东西，会不会她真的看到了什么？
sentences.sourceTitle: 16 Maria's Scared Dog · Maria 发抖的狗

sentences.english: Now, what's even more creepy about this is that Maria claims to have caught the ghost on camera.
sentences.chinese: 更吓人的是，Maria 声称她拍到了那个鬼。
sentences.sourceTitle: 16 Maria's Scared Dog · Maria 发抖的狗

sentences.english: According to her, there appears to be a face by the door.
sentences.chinese: 据她说，门边好像有一张脸。
sentences.sourceTitle: 16 Maria's Scared Dog · Maria 发抖的狗

sentences.english: If you look closely, you'll be able to see it.
sentences.chinese: 仔细看的话，你就能看到。
sentences.sourceTitle: 16 Maria's Scared Dog · Maria 发抖的狗

sentences.english: What exactly was causing Maria's dog to act this way?
sentences.chinese: 到底是什么让 Maria 的狗变成这样？
sentences.sourceTitle: 16 Maria's Scared Dog · Maria 发抖的狗

sentences.english: Celia Santos had posted the following video on Facebook and states that something terrifying had occurred at a mall in Brazil.
sentences.chinese: Celia Santos 在 Facebook 上发布了下面这段视频，说巴西的一家商场里发生了可怕的事。
sentences.sourceTitle: 17 The Mall Escalator · 商场扶梯上的小女孩

sentences.english: The video was taken at 2:30 in the morning by a security guard who works there.
sentences.chinese: 视频是在凌晨 2 点半由那里的一名保安拍的。
sentences.sourceTitle: 17 The Mall Escalator · 商场扶梯上的小女孩

sentences.english: He was sure that he was the only person inside, until he saw the following.
sentences.chinese: 他确信商场里只有他一个人，直到他看到了下面的画面。
sentences.sourceTitle: 17 The Mall Escalator · 商场扶梯上的小女孩

sentences.english: The security guard had recorded this in the hopes that people would believe him when telling them about this terrifying encounter.
sentences.chinese: 保安把它录了下来，希望他跟别人讲这次可怕的遭遇时，大家会相信他。
sentences.sourceTitle: 17 The Mall Escalator · 商场扶梯上的小女孩

sentences.english: This is what he caught.
sentences.chinese: 这就是他拍到的。
sentences.sourceTitle: 17 The Mall Escalator · 商场扶梯上的小女孩

sentences.english: There appears to be a little girl on the escalator, who then disappears moments later.
sentences.chinese: 扶梯上好像有一个小女孩，片刻之后就消失了。
sentences.sourceTitle: 17 The Mall Escalator · 商场扶梯上的小女孩

sentences.english: Now, this could have been an actual child, but what's a child doing inside a mall at 2 in the morning?
sentences.chinese: 当然，这可能真是个孩子，但凌晨两点，一个孩子在商场里干什么？
sentences.sourceTitle: 17 The Mall Escalator · 商场扶梯上的小女孩

sentences.english: I can't think of anything to explain this, other than this being a child who was accidentally locked inside.
sentences.chinese: 除了是一个不小心被锁在里面的孩子，我想不出别的解释。
sentences.sourceTitle: 17 The Mall Escalator · 商场扶梯上的小女孩

sentences.english: Now, what's even more strange about this is that the escalator was powered off during the time of this recording.
sentences.chinese: 更奇怪的是，拍摄时扶梯是断电停运的。
sentences.sourceTitle: 17 The Mall Escalator · 商场扶梯上的小女孩

sentences.english: Knowing this, it doesn't make sense that the child was able to travel up smoothly without taking a single step.
sentences.chinese: 知道这一点后，孩子一步都没走，却能平稳地往上移动，这就说不通了。
sentences.sourceTitle: 17 The Mall Escalator · 商场扶梯上的小女孩

sentences.english: All in all, this one's pretty creepy.
sentences.chinese: 总之，这一段挺吓人的。
sentences.sourceTitle: 17 The Mall Escalator · 商场扶梯上的小女孩

sentences.english: Fernando Victor works at a train station.
sentences.chinese: Fernando Victor 在一个火车站工作。
sentences.sourceTitle: 18 The Train Station · 火车站的夜班

sentences.english: What he does there specifically is unknown, but regardless of his task, he always seems to have late-night shifts.
sentences.chinese: 他具体做什么不清楚，但不管做什么，他似乎总是上深夜班。
sentences.sourceTitle: 18 The Train Station · 火车站的夜班

sentences.english: However, it was during a late-night shift when Fernando captures something terrifying on camera.
sentences.chinese: 然而，就是在一次深夜班上，Fernando 拍到了可怕的东西。
sentences.sourceTitle: 18 The Train Station · 火车站的夜班

sentences.english: Fernando and two other workers are walking beside a train that isn't in operation when, all of a sudden, he captures this without even noticing.
sentences.chinese: Fernando 和另外两名工人走在一列停运的火车旁，突然，他在毫无察觉的情况下拍到了这个。
sentences.sourceTitle: 18 The Train Station · 火车站的夜班

sentences.english: Someone or something appears to be looking at Fernando as he records them.
sentences.chinese: 在他拍摄时，好像有人或某种东西在看着 Fernando。
sentences.sourceTitle: 18 The Train Station · 火车站的夜班

sentences.english: What do you think this might have been?
sentences.chinese: 你觉得这会是什么？
sentences.sourceTitle: 18 The Train Station · 火车站的夜班

sentences.english: Viewers believe that this may have been the ghost of someone who was involved in a railroad accident.
sentences.chinese: 观众认为，这可能是某个死于铁路事故的人的鬼魂。
sentences.sourceTitle: 18 The Train Station · 火车站的夜班

sentences.english: Now, it could be that this was actually a person, but if it were, then how come this supposed person looks so creepy?
sentences.chinese: 当然，这也可能真是一个人，但如果是人，为什么看起来这么吓人？
sentences.sourceTitle: 18 The Train Station · 火车站的夜班

sentences.english: I don't know, but whoever this is looks too dead to be alive.
sentences.chinese: 我不知道，但不管这是谁，看起来都太像死人，不像活人。
sentences.sourceTitle: 18 The Train Station · 火车站的夜班

sentences.english: Whoever or whatever this is remains a mystery.
sentences.chinese: 这到底是谁、是什么，仍然是个谜。
sentences.sourceTitle: 18 The Train Station · 火车站的夜班

sentences.english: A father takes his wife and child to a theme park and, while recording them, captures something pretty creepy.
sentences.chinese: 一位父亲带着妻子和孩子去游乐园，在给她们拍视频时，拍到了相当诡异的东西。
sentences.sourceTitle: 19 The Hand at the Theme Park · 游乐园里的手

sentences.english: The father states that after coming back from the theme park, his daughter told them that she was scared of going back.
sentences.chinese: 父亲说，从游乐园回来后，女儿告诉他们，她害怕再去那里。
sentences.sourceTitle: 19 The Hand at the Theme Park · 游乐园里的手

sentences.english: But it wasn't because she was afraid of the rides, but because of something else.
sentences.chinese: 但不是因为她怕那些游乐设施，而是因为别的东西。
sentences.sourceTitle: 19 The Hand at the Theme Park · 游乐园里的手

sentences.english: It was only after looking back at the footage he took that he understood why his daughter was so afraid.
sentences.chinese: 直到回看自己拍的视频，他才明白女儿为什么那么害怕。
sentences.sourceTitle: 19 The Hand at the Theme Park · 游乐园里的手

sentences.english: This is what he caught.
sentences.chinese: 这就是他拍到的。
sentences.sourceTitle: 19 The Hand at the Theme Park · 游乐园里的手

sentences.english: Be sure to look closely, or you'll miss it.
sentences.chinese: 一定要仔细看，不然就错过了。
sentences.sourceTitle: 19 The Hand at the Theme Park · 游乐园里的手

sentences.english: Right behind his daughter, there appears to be a hand coming out of nowhere.
sentences.chinese: 就在他女儿身后，好像凭空伸出了一只手。
sentences.sourceTitle: 19 The Hand at the Theme Park · 游乐园里的手

sentences.english: The scariest part about this, though, is the fact that it seems to be reaching out to her.
sentences.chinese: 不过最吓人的是，那只手好像正伸向她。
sentences.sourceTitle: 19 The Hand at the Theme Park · 游乐园里的手

sentences.english: But something else was caught on camera that also went unnoticed.
sentences.chinese: 但镜头还拍到了另一样同样没人注意到的东西。
sentences.sourceTitle: 19 The Hand at the Theme Park · 游乐园里的手

sentences.english: Earlier in the video, the father is recording a boat that's passing by when, out of nowhere, he captures this.
sentences.chinese: 在视频前面，父亲正在拍一艘经过的船，突然，他拍到了这个。
sentences.sourceTitle: 19 The Hand at the Theme Park · 游乐园里的手

sentences.english: I honestly have no explanation for this, but I have plenty of questions.
sentences.chinese: 说实话，我解释不了这个，但我有一大堆疑问。
sentences.sourceTitle: 19 The Hand at the Theme Park · 游乐园里的手

sentences.english: I can't help but think that this might have been the same hand that appears later on.
sentences.chinese: 我忍不住觉得，这可能就是后面出现的那只手。
sentences.sourceTitle: 19 The Hand at the Theme Park · 游乐园里的手

sentences.english: But what's even more creepy about this is that it seems to be trying to get the father's attention.
sentences.chinese: 但更吓人的是，它好像在试图引起父亲的注意。
sentences.sourceTitle: 19 The Hand at the Theme Park · 游乐园里的手

sentences.english: Or could it be that it was trying to get the daughter's?
sentences.chinese: 还是说，它想引起的是女儿的注意？
sentences.sourceTitle: 19 The Hand at the Theme Park · 游乐园里的手

sentences.english: There has yet to be an explanation for this, but as always, what are your thoughts?
sentences.chinese: 这件事至今没有解释，和往常一样，你怎么看？
sentences.sourceTitle: 19 The Hand at the Theme Park · 游乐园里的手

sentences.english: Ali Azlan is inside an abandoned house that's located in the middle of nowhere.
sentences.chinese: Ali Azlan 在一栋位于荒郊野外的废弃房子里。
sentences.sourceTitle: 20 The Abandoned House · 荒野中的废弃房子

sentences.english: There have only been a couple of people who've checked out this place, but not a single person had caught anything as unusual as Ali had when he paid a visit to this house.
sentences.chinese: 只有少数几个人来过这里，但没有一个人像 Ali 这次一样，拍到这么不寻常的东西。
sentences.sourceTitle: 20 The Abandoned House · 荒野中的废弃房子

sentences.english: Ali is exploring the place when, all of a sudden, this happens.
sentences.chinese: Ali 正在四处探索，突然发生了这件事。
sentences.sourceTitle: 20 The Abandoned House · 荒野中的废弃房子

sentences.english: Now, it's worth mentioning that during the time of this recording, it was raining.
sentences.chinese: 值得一提的是，拍摄时正在下雨。
sentences.sourceTitle: 20 The Abandoned House · 荒野中的废弃房子

sentences.english: It could be that the strange noises were actually caused by the storm outside.
sentences.chinese: 那些奇怪的声音可能其实是外面的暴风雨造成的。
sentences.sourceTitle: 20 The Abandoned House · 荒野中的废弃房子

sentences.english: That could be the case.
sentences.chinese: 有可能是这样。
sentences.sourceTitle: 20 The Abandoned House · 荒野中的废弃房子

sentences.english: But what happens afterward, as Ali exits the house, is beyond explanation.
sentences.chinese: 但之后 Ali 走出房子时发生的事，就无法解释了。
sentences.sourceTitle: 20 The Abandoned House · 荒野中的废弃房子

sentences.english: What he caught on camera is perhaps the creepiest encounter he's had.
sentences.chinese: 他拍到的，也许是他经历过的最诡异的一次遭遇。
sentences.sourceTitle: 20 The Abandoned House · 荒野中的废弃房子

sentences.english: Be sure to pay close attention, or you'll miss it.
sentences.chinese: 一定要仔细看，不然就错过了。
sentences.sourceTitle: 20 The Abandoned House · 荒野中的废弃房子

sentences.english: Ali doesn't know what to make of this, but if there's one thing that most viewers can agree on, it's that this person or thing was most likely observing Ali during the time he was inside.
sentences.chinese: Ali 不知道该怎么解释，但大多数观众都同意一点：Ali 在屋里时，这个人或东西很可能一直在观察他。
sentences.sourceTitle: 20 The Abandoned House · 荒野中的废弃房子

sentences.english: If that's not creepy, then I don't know what is.
sentences.chinese: 如果这还不算吓人，那我就不知道什么才算了。
sentences.sourceTitle: 20 The Abandoned House · 荒野中的废弃房子

sentences.english: Ryan Hulse writes, "So I was just sitting at home alone. The parents were out, and I kept hearing the weird sounds again.
sentences.chinese: Ryan Hulse 写道：“我一个人坐在家里，爸妈都出去了，我又一直听到那些奇怪的声音。
sentences.sourceTitle: 21 Home Alone · 独自在家

sentences.english: But this time, I decided to record for a change, and this is what I caught. Really creepy."
sentences.chinese: 但这次我决定换个做法，把它录下来，这就是我拍到的。真的很吓人。”
sentences.sourceTitle: 21 Home Alone · 独自在家

sentences.english: What the f—? This is what I mean. Crazy.
sentences.chinese: 什么鬼？我说的就是这个。太疯狂了。
sentences.sourceTitle: 21 Home Alone · 独自在家

sentences.english: Perhaps this might have been a stranger who broke in.
sentences.chinese: 这也许是一个闯进来的陌生人。
sentences.sourceTitle: 21 Home Alone · 独自在家

sentences.english: Intruder or ghost, it's unknown as to who or what was inside Ryan's house.
sentences.chinese: 是入侵者还是鬼？没人知道当时 Ryan 家里的是谁、是什么。
sentences.sourceTitle: 21 Home Alone · 独自在家

sentences.english: Ellen Melbergstead is on her way to a doctor's appointment and is taking a shortcut through a park to get there.
sentences.chinese: Ellen Melbergstead 正要去看医生，她抄近路穿过一个公园。
sentences.sourceTitle: 22 Shortcut Through the Park · 公园里的捷径

sentences.english: The video takes place in Sweden during the wintertime, so it's mostly dark during the day.
sentences.chinese: 视频拍摄于瑞典的冬天，所以白天大部分时间天都是黑的。
sentences.sourceTitle: 22 Shortcut Through the Park · 公园里的捷径

sentences.english: As she's on her way to the hospital, Ellen takes out her phone and begins to record.
sentences.chinese: 在去医院的路上，Ellen 拿出手机开始录像。
sentences.sourceTitle: 22 Shortcut Through the Park · 公园里的捷径

sentences.english: But little does she know that she's about to capture something downright creepy.
sentences.chinese: 但她完全没想到，她即将拍到非常诡异的东西。
sentences.sourceTitle: 22 Shortcut Through the Park · 公园里的捷径

sentences.english: Check this out.
sentences.chinese: 来看看。
sentences.sourceTitle: 22 Shortcut Through the Park · 公园里的捷径

sentences.english: It was only after viewers had pointed this out that Ellen had noticed it.
sentences.chinese: 直到观众指出来，Ellen 才注意到。
sentences.sourceTitle: 22 Shortcut Through the Park · 公园里的捷径

sentences.english: There appears to be a figure peeking at Ellen from behind a tree.
sentences.chinese: 好像有一个人影躲在树后偷看 Ellen。
sentences.sourceTitle: 22 Shortcut Through the Park · 公园里的捷径

sentences.english: It's unclear as to who or what this might have been, but viewers think that this could have been a ghost.
sentences.chinese: 不清楚这是谁或是什么，但观众认为这可能是鬼。
sentences.sourceTitle: 22 Shortcut Through the Park · 公园里的捷径

sentences.english: Whatever it might have been, Ellen will most likely be taking a different route from now on.
sentences.chinese: 不管是什么，Ellen 以后很可能都会换一条路走了。
sentences.sourceTitle: 22 Shortcut Through the Park · 公园里的捷径

sentences.english: Grisel Luna is conducting a paranormal investigation at a place where human remains were found.
sentences.chinese: Grisel Luna 正在一个发现过人类遗骸的地方做灵异调查。
sentences.sourceTitle: 23 The Bone · 那根骨头

sentences.english: The site has been abandoned for a while and is known to be a hot spot for paranormal activity.
sentences.chinese: 这个地方已经荒废了一段时间，以灵异活动频繁而出名。
sentences.sourceTitle: 23 The Bone · 那根骨头

sentences.english: While checking out one of the rooms inside the building, this happens.
sentences.chinese: 她在楼里查看其中一个房间时，发生了这件事。
sentences.sourceTitle: 23 The Bone · 那根骨头

sentences.english: Later on, Grisel goes outside and finds something pretty disturbing.
sentences.chinese: 后来，Grisel 走到外面，发现了相当让人不安的东西。
sentences.sourceTitle: 23 The Bone · 那根骨头

sentences.english: I'm not sure if picking up the bone was a good idea, because what happens next might have been the result of having done so.
sentences.chinese: 我不确定捡起那根骨头是不是个好主意，因为接下来发生的事，可能就是这么做的后果。
sentences.sourceTitle: 23 The Bone · 那根骨头

sentences.english: It's not clear as to what happened here, but whatever occurred, I'm sure it wasn't good, as given by the history of this place.
sentences.chinese: 不清楚这里发生了什么，但不管是什么，考虑到这个地方的历史，我敢肯定不是好事。
sentences.sourceTitle: 23 The Bone · 那根骨头

sentences.english: Facebook user Yingy Vong writes, "So something crazy happened tonight.
sentences.chinese: Facebook 用户 Yingy Vong 写道：“今晚发生了一件疯狂的事。
sentences.sourceTitle: 24 Ghost Rider · 自己骑走的三轮车

sentences.english: My motion-activated security camera turned on.
sentences.chinese: 我的感应式监控摄像头启动了。
sentences.sourceTitle: 24 Ghost Rider · 自己骑走的三轮车

sentences.english: I grabbed my phone to see a live feed of what was happening outside.
sentences.chinese: 我拿起手机看外面的实时画面。
sentences.sourceTitle: 24 Ghost Rider · 自己骑走的三轮车

sentences.english: I couldn't believe what I saw."
sentences.chinese: 我简直不敢相信自己看到了什么。”
sentences.sourceTitle: 24 Ghost Rider · 自己骑走的三轮车

sentences.english: Talk about Ghost Rider!
sentences.chinese: 这简直就是“恶灵骑士”！
sentences.sourceTitle: 24 Ghost Rider · 自己骑走的三轮车

sentences.english: If the tricycle hadn't stopped and turned, I would have guessed the wind moved it.
sentences.chinese: 如果那辆三轮车没有停下来再转弯，我会以为是风吹动了它。
sentences.sourceTitle: 24 Ghost Rider · 自己骑走的三轮车

sentences.english: But as you can see, that doesn't seem to be the case.
sentences.chinese: 但正如你看到的，似乎并不是这样。
sentences.sourceTitle: 24 Ghost Rider · 自己骑走的三轮车

sentences.english: Susie Somori lives in a three-story house with lots of stairs and several rooms.
sentences.chinese: Susie Somori 住在一栋三层楼的房子里，楼梯很多，房间也不少。
sentences.sourceTitle: 25 Gilbert and the Sun Painting · Gilbert 与太阳壁画

sentences.english: Out of all the rooms, there's one in particular that she stays away from.
sentences.chinese: 在所有房间里，有一间她特别躲着不去。
sentences.sourceTitle: 25 Gilbert and the Sun Painting · Gilbert 与太阳壁画

sentences.english: On the third floor, there's a large vacant room with the painting of a sun on one of its walls.
sentences.chinese: 三楼有一间空荡荡的大房间，其中一面墙上画着一个太阳。
sentences.sourceTitle: 25 Gilbert and the Sun Painting · Gilbert 与太阳壁画

sentences.english: She doesn't know why, but there's something about this painting that makes her feel very uneasy.
sentences.chinese: 她也不知道为什么，但这幅画总让她感到很不安。
sentences.sourceTitle: 25 Gilbert and the Sun Painting · Gilbert 与太阳壁画

sentences.english: It might be the ambience of the room, but she can't help but feel like the painting is responsible for the dreaded feeling she gets whenever she walks in.
sentences.chinese: 也许是房间的氛围，但她总忍不住觉得，每次走进去时那种恐惧感，都是这幅画造成的。
sentences.sourceTitle: 25 Gilbert and the Sun Painting · Gilbert 与太阳壁画

sentences.english: So, thinking it's all in her head, she tries her best to ignore this feeling.
sentences.chinese: 于是，她觉得这都是自己想多了，尽力不去理会这种感觉。
sentences.sourceTitle: 25 Gilbert and the Sun Painting · Gilbert 与太阳壁画

sentences.english: But then, one night, Susie encounters something that scared the living daylights out of her.
sentences.chinese: 可有一天晚上，Susie 遇到了一件把她吓得魂飞魄散的事。
sentences.sourceTitle: 25 Gilbert and the Sun Painting · Gilbert 与太阳壁画

sentences.english: Susie is home alone when she captures the following on camera.
sentences.chinese: Susie 一个人在家时，拍到了下面的画面。
sentences.sourceTitle: 25 Gilbert and the Sun Painting · Gilbert 与太阳壁画

sentences.english: Susie ends the video there, but little does she know that things were about to get worse.
sentences.chinese: Susie 的视频到这里就结束了，但她没想到，事情还会变得更糟。
sentences.sourceTitle: 25 Gilbert and the Sun Painting · Gilbert 与太阳壁画

sentences.english: One day, Susie's niece is playing inside the room, and while spying on her, she captures this.
sentences.chinese: 有一天，Susie 的侄女在那个房间里玩，Susie 偷偷看着她，拍到了这个。
sentences.sourceTitle: 25 Gilbert and the Sun Painting · Gilbert 与太阳壁画

sentences.english: Her niece appears to be talking to the painting, as though she's having a conversation with it.
sentences.chinese: 侄女好像在和那幅画说话，就像在和它聊天一样。
sentences.sourceTitle: 25 Gilbert and the Sun Painting · Gilbert 与太阳壁画

sentences.english: Susie didn't like this, and so she asked her as to who she was talking to.
sentences.chinese: Susie 不喜欢这样，于是问她在和谁说话。
sentences.sourceTitle: 25 Gilbert and the Sun Painting · Gilbert 与太阳壁画

sentences.english: This is what she said.
sentences.chinese: 这是她的回答。
sentences.sourceTitle: 25 Gilbert and the Sun Painting · Gilbert 与太阳壁画

sentences.english: Do you like him?
sentences.chinese: 你喜欢他吗？
sentences.sourceTitle: 25 Gilbert and the Sun Painting · Gilbert 与太阳壁画

sentences.english: Yes. Gilbert's like one of my best friends.
sentences.chinese: 喜欢。Gilbert 就像我最好的朋友之一。
sentences.sourceTitle: 25 Gilbert and the Sun Painting · Gilbert 与太阳壁画

sentences.english: Where did it come from?
sentences.chinese: 它是从哪儿来的？
sentences.sourceTitle: 25 Gilbert and the Sun Painting · Gilbert 与太阳壁画

sentences.english: I don't know. I think the man that used to live here painted it.
sentences.chinese: 我不知道。我想是以前住在这里的那个人画的。
sentences.sourceTitle: 25 Gilbert and the Sun Painting · Gilbert 与太阳壁画

sentences.english: Is Gilbert friendly? Does he speak to you?
sentences.chinese: Gilbert 友好吗？他会跟你说话吗？
sentences.sourceTitle: 25 Gilbert and the Sun Painting · Gilbert 与太阳壁画

sentences.english: Yeah.
sentences.chinese: 会。
sentences.sourceTitle: 25 Gilbert and the Sun Painting · Gilbert 与太阳壁画

sentences.english: What does he say?
sentences.chinese: 他说什么？
sentences.sourceTitle: 25 Gilbert and the Sun Painting · Gilbert 与太阳壁画

sentences.english: Because I don't pray.
sentences.chinese: 因为我不祈祷。
sentences.sourceTitle: 25 Gilbert and the Sun Painting · Gilbert 与太阳壁画

sentences.english: Susie doesn't know what to make of this.
sentences.chinese: Susie 不知道该怎么理解这件事。
sentences.sourceTitle: 25 Gilbert and the Sun Painting · Gilbert 与太阳壁画

sentences.english: It seems that her niece had befriended Gilbert, the painting on the wall.
sentences.chinese: 看来侄女和墙上那幅画“Gilbert”交上了朋友。
sentences.sourceTitle: 25 Gilbert and the Sun Painting · Gilbert 与太阳壁画

sentences.english: She's made an imaginary friend.
sentences.chinese: 她有了一个想象中的朋友。
sentences.sourceTitle: 25 Gilbert and the Sun Painting · Gilbert 与太阳壁画

sentences.english: But the things said by this so-called friend doesn't sit well with Susie.
sentences.chinese: 但这个所谓的“朋友”说的话，让 Susie 很不舒服。
sentences.sourceTitle: 25 Gilbert and the Sun Painting · Gilbert 与太阳壁画

sentences.english: And so, she decides to spy on her once more.
sentences.chinese: 于是，她决定再偷偷观察她一次。
sentences.sourceTitle: 25 Gilbert and the Sun Painting · Gilbert 与太阳壁画

sentences.english: But this time, she captures something even more strange.
sentences.chinese: 但这一次，她拍到了更奇怪的东西。
sentences.sourceTitle: 25 Gilbert and the Sun Painting · Gilbert 与太阳壁画

sentences.english: Her niece appears to be looking for something underneath the floorboard.
sentences.chinese: 侄女好像在地板下面找什么东西。
sentences.sourceTitle: 25 Gilbert and the Sun Painting · Gilbert 与太阳壁画

sentences.english: It was only after her niece had fallen asleep that she decided to investigate the spot.
sentences.chinese: 等侄女睡着后，她才决定去查看那个地方。
sentences.sourceTitle: 25 Gilbert and the Sun Painting · Gilbert 与太阳壁画

sentences.english: She checks it out and ends up finding something disturbing.
sentences.chinese: 她去查看，结果发现了让人不安的东西。
sentences.sourceTitle: 25 Gilbert and the Sun Painting · Gilbert 与太阳壁画

sentences.english: Take a look.
sentences.chinese: 来看看。
sentences.sourceTitle: 25 Gilbert and the Sun Painting · Gilbert 与太阳壁画

sentences.english: Needless to say, Susie was speechless.
sentences.chinese: 不用说，Susie 惊得说不出话来。
sentences.sourceTitle: 25 Gilbert and the Sun Painting · Gilbert 与太阳壁画

sentences.english: What's more strange about this is the Ouija board itself.
sentences.chinese: 更奇怪的是那块通灵板本身。
sentences.sourceTitle: 25 Gilbert and the Sun Painting · Gilbert 与太阳壁画

sentences.english: If you look closely, the board appears to have the same painting of the sun that's on the wall.
sentences.chinese: 仔细看，通灵板上好像画着和墙上一模一样的太阳。
sentences.sourceTitle: 25 Gilbert and the Sun Painting · Gilbert 与太阳壁画

sentences.english: This can't be a coincidence.
sentences.chinese: 这不可能是巧合。
sentences.sourceTitle: 25 Gilbert and the Sun Painting · Gilbert 与太阳壁画

sentences.english: Susie is certain that the board is somehow connected to the painting.
sentences.chinese: Susie 确信这块板和那幅画之间有某种联系。
sentences.sourceTitle: 25 Gilbert and the Sun Painting · Gilbert 与太阳壁画

sentences.english: This unsettling discovery has led Susie into researching the history of her home.
sentences.chinese: 这个令人不安的发现，让 Susie 开始调查这栋房子的历史。
sentences.sourceTitle: 25 Gilbert and the Sun Painting · Gilbert 与太阳壁画

sentences.english: And after much research, she found this.
sentences.chinese: 经过大量调查，她找到了这个。
sentences.sourceTitle: 25 Gilbert and the Sun Painting · Gilbert 与太阳壁画

sentences.english: Here is a photo of the house from 1916, and it was built in 1902.
sentences.chinese: 这是这栋房子 1916 年的照片，房子建于 1902 年。
sentences.sourceTitle: 25 Gilbert and the Sun Painting · Gilbert 与太阳壁画

sentences.english: So this would be the first, or one of the first, families to live in this house.
sentences.chinese: 所以这应该是第一户，或者最早的几户住在这里的人家之一。
sentences.sourceTitle: 25 Gilbert and the Sun Painting · Gilbert 与太阳壁画

sentences.english: As you can see, there are six people present in the photo.
sentences.chinese: 你可以看到，照片里有六个人。
sentences.sourceTitle: 25 Gilbert and the Sun Painting · Gilbert 与太阳壁画

sentences.english: Looking at the English census records, I found that the father would be called John.
sentences.chinese: 查了英国的人口普查记录后，我发现父亲叫 John。
sentences.sourceTitle: 25 Gilbert and the Sun Painting · Gilbert 与太阳壁画

sentences.english: The mother was called Maude. Next, round the balcony, is her daughter, Dorothy.
sentences.chinese: 母亲叫 Maude。接着，在阳台那边的是她的女儿 Dorothy。
sentences.sourceTitle: 25 Gilbert and the Sun Painting · Gilbert 与太阳壁画

sentences.english: The birth of a little boy called Gilbert was also registered here in 1911, so he would be about five or six in this photo.
sentences.chinese: 1911 年这里还登记过一个叫 Gilbert 的小男孩出生，所以拍这张照片时他应该五六岁。
sentences.sourceTitle: 25 Gilbert and the Sun Painting · Gilbert 与太阳壁画

sentences.english: I'm not sure why he's not with the rest of his family in the photo, or what they did to him.
sentences.chinese: 我不知道他为什么没和家里其他人一起出现在照片里，也不知道他们对他做了什么。
sentences.sourceTitle: 25 Gilbert and the Sun Painting · Gilbert 与太阳壁画

sentences.english: I just have an overwhelming feeling that something really terrible happened to him at the hands of his own family.
sentences.chinese: 我就是有一种强烈的感觉：他的家人对他做了非常可怕的事。
sentences.sourceTitle: 25 Gilbert and the Sun Painting · Gilbert 与太阳壁画

sentences.english: The weirdest part is that this is where the sun painting is situated in the house. That's his room.
sentences.chinese: 最诡异的是，太阳壁画就在房子的这个位置。那是他的房间。
sentences.sourceTitle: 25 Gilbert and the Sun Painting · Gilbert 与太阳壁画

sentences.english: Gilbert was the name of a child who used to live in her house, and whose room has the painting of the sun, which seems to have been named after him.
sentences.chinese: Gilbert 是一个曾经住在她家里的孩子的名字，那间画着太阳的房间就是他的，而那幅画似乎就是以他命名的。
sentences.sourceTitle: 25 Gilbert and the Sun Painting · Gilbert 与太阳壁画

sentences.english: She has yet to post more info on the history of her home.
sentences.chinese: 关于房子的历史，她还没有公布更多信息。
sentences.sourceTitle: 25 Gilbert and the Sun Painting · Gilbert 与太阳壁画

sentences.english: For now, she continues researching in the hopes of putting an end to this mystery.
sentences.chinese: 目前，她还在继续调查，希望能解开这个谜团。
sentences.sourceTitle: 25 Gilbert and the Sun Painting · Gilbert 与太阳壁画

sentences.english: Is Gilbert the supposed ghost that talks to her niece, or is it something else?
sentences.chinese: Gilbert 就是那个和她侄女说话的鬼吗，还是另有其物？
sentences.sourceTitle: 25 Gilbert and the Sun Painting · Gilbert 与太阳壁画

sentences.english: A group of friends are at a fair, riding the pirate ship ride, when one of them captures something disturbing on camera.
sentences.chinese: 一群朋友在游乐会上坐海盗船，其中一人用镜头拍到了让人不安的东西。
sentences.sourceTitle: 26 The Pirate Ship Ride · 海盗船上少了一个人

sentences.english: The person who caught this writes, "Before coming to this fair, I've heard stories of a woman who had tragically died after falling off from one of the rides here.
sentences.chinese: 拍到这段的人写道：“来这个游乐会之前，我听说过一个女人从这里的游乐设施上摔下来、不幸身亡的故事。
sentences.sourceTitle: 26 The Pirate Ship Ride · 海盗船上少了一个人

sentences.english: But that was many years ago.
sentences.chinese: 但那是很多年前的事了。
sentences.sourceTitle: 26 The Pirate Ship Ride · 海盗船上少了一个人

sentences.english: This video was taken in 2008, at around 10 PM."
sentences.chinese: 这段视频拍摄于 2008 年，大约晚上 10 点。”
sentences.sourceTitle: 26 The Pirate Ship Ride · 海盗船上少了一个人

sentences.english: This is what was captured.
sentences.chinese: 这就是拍到的画面。
sentences.sourceTitle: 26 The Pirate Ship Ride · 海盗船上少了一个人

sentences.english: Be sure to pay close attention to the background, or you'll miss it.
sentences.chinese: 一定要仔细看背景，不然就错过了。
sentences.sourceTitle: 26 The Pirate Ship Ride · 海盗船上少了一个人

sentences.english: At first, there are four people sitting next to each other, but then a few seconds later, there's one less person.
sentences.chinese: 一开始有四个人并排坐着，但几秒钟后，少了一个人。
sentences.sourceTitle: 26 The Pirate Ship Ride · 海盗船上少了一个人

sentences.english: It appears that the passenger on the left has disappeared.
sentences.chinese: 看起来左边的那位乘客消失了。
sentences.sourceTitle: 26 The Pirate Ship Ride · 海盗船上少了一个人

sentences.english: The man recording this has no idea as to who she is, and still doesn't know to this day.
sentences.chinese: 拍摄的人完全不知道她是谁，直到今天也不知道。
sentences.sourceTitle: 26 The Pirate Ship Ride · 海盗船上少了一个人

sentences.english: However, he can't help but think that this might have been the woman who had tragically died at this fair many years ago.
sentences.chinese: 不过，他忍不住觉得，这可能就是多年前在这个游乐会上不幸身亡的那个女人。
sentences.sourceTitle: 26 The Pirate Ship Ride · 海盗船上少了一个人

sentences.english: Viewers think so too, and have even pointed out that her face looks injured in a couple of frames.
sentences.chinese: 观众也这么认为，甚至指出在几帧画面里，她的脸看起来是受伤的。
sentences.sourceTitle: 26 The Pirate Ship Ride · 海盗船上少了一个人

sentences.english: Now that's creepy.
sentences.chinese: 这就很吓人了。
sentences.sourceTitle: 26 The Pirate Ship Ride · 海盗船上少了一个人

sentences.english: But of course, what do you think?
sentences.chinese: 当然，你怎么看？
sentences.sourceTitle: 26 The Pirate Ship Ride · 海盗船上少了一个人

sentences.english: Was a ghost caught on camera, or was this all just an illusion?
sentences.chinese: 是镜头拍到了鬼，还是这一切只是错觉？
sentences.sourceTitle: 26 The Pirate Ship Ride · 海盗船上少了一个人

sentences.english: As always, feel free to let me know what you think.
sentences.chinese: 和往常一样，欢迎告诉我你的看法。
sentences.sourceTitle: 26 The Pirate Ship Ride · 海盗船上少了一个人

sentences.english: "My husband works nights at a high school that was built in 1877.
sentences.chinese: “我丈夫在一所建于 1877 年的高中上夜班。
sentences.sourceTitle: 27 The Old High School · 老高中的夜班

sentences.english: He's always told me it's been haunted, and he has seen and heard weird stuff.
sentences.chinese: 他一直跟我说那里闹鬼，他也见过、听过一些怪事。
sentences.sourceTitle: 27 The Old High School · 老高中的夜班

sentences.english: But with the schools being closed since COVID, things have been a little strange recently.
sentences.chinese: 但自从新冠疫情学校关闭以来，最近情况有点怪。
sentences.sourceTitle: 27 The Old High School · 老高中的夜班

sentences.english: Last night, they had some construction workers in, and one of the guys was freaking out because he said someone kept whispering in his ear.
sentences.chinese: 昨晚有几个施工工人在学校里，其中一个人吓坏了，因为他说一直有人在他耳边低语。
sentences.sourceTitle: 27 The Old High School · 老高中的夜班

sentences.english: And he didn't seem to believe my husband when he said that the school was haunted.
sentences.chinese: 而且我丈夫说学校闹鬼时，他好像还不信。
sentences.sourceTitle: 27 The Old High School · 老高中的夜班

sentences.english: Later, one of my husband's colleagues saw something in his peripheral vision a couple of times, so he took a picture where he kept seeing it.
sentences.chinese: 后来，我丈夫的一个同事有好几次用余光瞥见了什么，于是他朝那个一直看到东西的地方拍了张照片。
sentences.sourceTitle: 27 The Old High School · 老高中的夜班

sentences.english: This is what he caught on camera."
sentences.chinese: 这就是他拍到的。”
sentences.sourceTitle: 27 The Old High School · 老高中的夜班

sentences.english: This is that one kid who slept in class and nobody woke up.
sentences.chinese: 这就是那个在课堂上睡着了、却没人叫醒的孩子。
sentences.sourceTitle: 27 The Old High School · 老高中的夜班

sentences.english: In all seriousness, though, this photo remains a mystery.
sentences.chinese: 不过说正经的，这张照片至今仍是个谜。
sentences.sourceTitle: 27 The Old High School · 老高中的夜班

sentences.english: But I can't help but think that the history of the school might give an explanation to this image.
sentences.chinese: 但我忍不住觉得，这所学校的历史也许能解释这张照片。
sentences.sourceTitle: 27 The Old High School · 老高中的夜班

sentences.english: All in all, this photo is pretty creepy.
sentences.chinese: 总之，这张照片挺吓人的。
sentences.sourceTitle: 27 The Old High School · 老高中的夜班

sentences.english: Emax is a ghost hunter on YouTube who explores abandoned places.
sentences.chinese: Emax 是 YouTube 上的一名“鬼魂猎人”，专门探索废弃的地方。
sentences.sourceTitle: 28 The Abandoned Hospital · 台湾的废弃医院

sentences.english: Not too long ago, he explored an abandoned hospital in Taiwan, where he encountered strange activity.
sentences.chinese: 不久前，他探索了台湾的一家废弃医院，在那里遇到了怪事。
sentences.sourceTitle: 28 The Abandoned Hospital · 台湾的废弃医院

sentences.english: He decides to revisit that same hospital in the hopes of capturing more activity, and he actually does, but it may have been more than he expected.
sentences.chinese: 他决定重访那家医院，希望拍到更多怪事。他确实拍到了，但可能远远超出了他的预期。
sentences.sourceTitle: 28 The Abandoned Hospital · 台湾的废弃医院

sentences.english: There's no doubting that Emax was left feeling spooked.
sentences.chinese: 毫无疑问，Emax 被吓到了。
sentences.sourceTitle: 28 The Abandoned Hospital · 台湾的废弃医院

sentences.english: But all of this pales in comparison to what happens next.
sentences.chinese: 但和接下来发生的事相比，这些都不算什么。
sentences.sourceTitle: 28 The Abandoned Hospital · 台湾的废弃医院

sentences.english: Coming back to this place might have upset the ghost that haunts it.
sentences.chinese: 回到这里，可能惹恼了在这里作祟的鬼。
sentences.sourceTitle: 28 The Abandoned Hospital · 台湾的废弃医院

sentences.english: Slamming the door repeatedly kind of makes it seem like it was irritated by Emax's return.
sentences.chinese: 一次又一次地摔门，看起来像是它对 Emax 的回来很恼火。
sentences.sourceTitle: 28 The Abandoned Hospital · 台湾的废弃医院

sentences.english: With activity like this, it makes you wonder if a poltergeist was present, or if it was something else.
sentences.chinese: 发生这样的事，不禁让人怀疑是不是有恶作剧鬼在场，还是别的什么东西。
sentences.sourceTitle: 28 The Abandoned Hospital · 台湾的废弃医院

sentences.english: If you caught something creepy on camera, or if there's any ghost videos you'd like me to check out and include in the next compilation, you can send them over to scaryvideos444@gmail.com.
sentences.chinese: 如果你拍到了诡异的东西，或者有想让我看看、放进下一期合集的鬼视频，可以发到 scaryvideos444@gmail.com。
sentences.sourceTitle: 28 The Abandoned Hospital · 台湾的废弃医院

sentences.english: That being said, let's get back to the video.
sentences.chinese: 说完这些，我们回到视频。
sentences.sourceTitle: 28 The Abandoned Hospital · 台湾的废弃医院

sentences.english: Marlene White is inside her bathroom when she captures something really creepy on camera.
sentences.chinese: Marlene White 在浴室里时，拍到了非常诡异的东西。
sentences.sourceTitle: 29 Marlene's Bathroom · Marlene 的浴室

sentences.english: Marlene writes, "Please tell me that I'm not crazy."
sentences.chinese: Marlene 写道：“请告诉我，我没有疯。”
sentences.sourceTitle: 29 Marlene's Bathroom · Marlene 的浴室

sentences.english: Here's the video she posted, along with the text-to-speech voice that she uses to explain what's going on.
sentences.chinese: 这是她发布的视频，她用文字转语音的声音来解释发生了什么。
sentences.sourceTitle: 29 Marlene's Bathroom · Marlene 的浴室

sentences.english: What the hell is this?
sentences.chinese: 这到底是什么鬼？
sentences.sourceTitle: 29 Marlene's Bathroom · Marlene 的浴室

sentences.english: I only have one baby at my house today. The rest of them are with Grandma.
sentences.chinese: 今天家里只有一个孩子，其他孩子都在外婆家。
sentences.sourceTitle: 29 Marlene's Bathroom · Marlene 的浴室

sentences.english: You can clearly hear my baby in the living room crying.
sentences.chinese: 你能清楚听到我的孩子在客厅里哭。
sentences.sourceTitle: 29 Marlene's Bathroom · Marlene 的浴室

sentences.english: I was on the toilet when I felt like something was watching me.
sentences.chinese: 我坐在马桶上时，感觉有什么东西在盯着我。
sentences.sourceTitle: 29 Marlene's Bathroom · Marlene 的浴室

sentences.english: I've been on edge ever since.
sentences.chinese: 从那以后我就一直很紧张。
sentences.sourceTitle: 29 Marlene's Bathroom · Marlene 的浴室

sentences.english: I took a picture, and my dad was behind me by the door, so I decided to turn the camera on and record.
sentences.chinese: 我拍了张照片，照片里我爸就在我身后的门边，所以我决定打开摄像头录像。
sentences.sourceTitle: 29 Marlene's Bathroom · Marlene 的浴室

sentences.english: This is not my dad. I don't know what it is.
sentences.chinese: 这不是我爸。我不知道它是什么。
sentences.sourceTitle: 29 Marlene's Bathroom · Marlene 的浴室

sentences.english: I know you've seen it move before and after I gasp.
sentences.chinese: 我知道你们看到了：在我倒吸一口气之前和之后，它都动了。
sentences.sourceTitle: 29 Marlene's Bathroom · Marlene 的浴室

sentences.english: Who are you?
sentences.chinese: 你是谁？
sentences.sourceTitle: 29 Marlene's Bathroom · Marlene 的浴室

sentences.english: Now, it kind of looks like someone is standing inside.
sentences.chinese: 看起来有点像有人站在里面。
sentences.sourceTitle: 29 Marlene's Bathroom · Marlene 的浴室

sentences.english: Maybe it's one of her children.
sentences.chinese: 也许是她的某个孩子。
sentences.sourceTitle: 29 Marlene's Bathroom · Marlene 的浴室

sentences.english: But Marlene disproves this notion by showing us what it would actually look like if one of her children were standing inside.
sentences.chinese: 但 Marlene 为了推翻这种说法，给我们演示了如果真是她的孩子站在里面，会是什么样子。
sentences.sourceTitle: 29 Marlene's Bathroom · Marlene 的浴室

sentences.english: Stand in the shower real quick so I can show people something.
sentences.chinese: 快去淋浴间里站一下，我给大家看个东西。
sentences.sourceTitle: 29 Marlene's Bathroom · Marlene 的浴室

sentences.english: Please shut the door.
sentences.chinese: 请把门关上。
sentences.sourceTitle: 29 Marlene's Bathroom · Marlene 的浴室

sentences.english: Okay, you can get out. Come here, child.
sentences.chinese: 好了，你可以出来了。过来，孩子。
sentences.sourceTitle: 29 Marlene's Bathroom · Marlene 的浴室

sentences.english: This is literally what you guys want, like...
sentences.chinese: 这就是你们想看的……
sentences.sourceTitle: 29 Marlene's Bathroom · Marlene 的浴室

sentences.english: That was not my babies in the shower.
sentences.chinese: 淋浴间里的不是我的孩子。
sentences.sourceTitle: 29 Marlene's Bathroom · Marlene 的浴室

sentences.english: Please just stop. There's no way.
sentences.chinese: 别再说了，不可能的。
sentences.sourceTitle: 29 Marlene's Bathroom · Marlene 的浴室

sentences.english: I would never get in that scary thing. I'm so scared.
sentences.chinese: 我才不会进那个吓人的地方。我好害怕。
sentences.sourceTitle: 29 Marlene's Bathroom · Marlene 的浴室

sentences.english: Marlene has no idea as to what this might be, but viewers can't help but think that this might have been a ghost.
sentences.chinese: Marlene 完全不知道这是什么，但观众忍不住觉得这可能是鬼。
sentences.sourceTitle: 29 Marlene's Bathroom · Marlene 的浴室

sentences.english: But what do you think?
sentences.chinese: 你怎么看？
sentences.sourceTitle: 29 Marlene's Bathroom · Marlene 的浴室

sentences.english: Ghost or illusion?
sentences.chinese: 是鬼，还是错觉？
sentences.sourceTitle: 29 Marlene's Bathroom · Marlene 的浴室

sentences.english: If you hate dolls, then you'll probably want to skip this one, as what's captured in it is just terrifying.
sentences.chinese: 如果你讨厌玩偶，那这一段你最好跳过，因为拍到的东西实在太吓人了。
sentences.sourceTitle: 30 The Doll's Head · 自己转头的玩偶

sentences.english: A girl is playing with her doll when the following happens.
sentences.chinese: 一个女孩正在玩她的玩偶，接着发生了下面的事。
sentences.sourceTitle: 30 The Doll's Head · 自己转头的玩偶

sentences.english: Be sure to pay close attention to the doll, or you'll miss it.
sentences.chinese: 一定要仔细盯着玩偶，不然就错过了。
sentences.sourceTitle: 30 The Doll's Head · 自己转头的玩偶

sentences.english: As she plays with her toy, the doll moves its head all on its own.
sentences.chinese: 她玩的时候，玩偶自己转动了头。
sentences.sourceTitle: 30 The Doll's Head · 自己转头的玩偶

sentences.english: Now, it could be that the doll has a built-in feature that allows it to move.
sentences.chinese: 当然，也可能是玩偶本身有能动的功能。
sentences.sourceTitle: 30 The Doll's Head · 自己转头的玩偶

sentences.english: But based on how she reacted upon seeing this, it seems like this wasn't a feature built into the doll.
sentences.chinese: 但从她看到后的反应来看，这似乎不是玩偶自带的功能。
sentences.sourceTitle: 30 The Doll's Head · 自己转头的玩偶

sentences.english: Viewers seem to agree and suggest that the doll is haunted, but as always, I'll let you be the judge of that.
sentences.chinese: 观众似乎也这么认为，说这个玩偶闹鬼，但和往常一样，由你来判断。
sentences.sourceTitle: 30 The Doll's Head · 自己转头的玩偶

sentences.english: The video you're about to see was posted by Andy Winehouse, who, in the follow-up video, recorded this.
sentences.chinese: 接下来的视频是 Andy Winehouse 发布的，他在后续视频里录了这段话。
sentences.sourceTitle: 31 The Voice That Copied Andy · 模仿 Andy 声音的东西

sentences.english: Okay, for anybody asking, this is my family home.
sentences.chinese: 好，回答一下大家的问题：这是我家的老房子。
sentences.sourceTitle: 31 The Voice That Copied Andy · 模仿 Andy 声音的东西

sentences.english: I grew up here, and we've never had a single experience like this.
sentences.chinese: 我在这里长大，我们从来没遇到过这样的事。
sentences.sourceTitle: 31 The Voice That Copied Andy · 模仿 Andy 声音的东西

sentences.english: I don't know what is going on.
sentences.chinese: 我不知道到底是怎么回事。
sentences.sourceTitle: 31 The Voice That Copied Andy · 模仿 Andy 声音的东西

sentences.english: I'm getting a lot of comments saying I'm doing it for views and I'm doing it for likes, and I promise you I'm not.
sentences.chinese: 很多评论说我是为了流量、为了点赞，我向你们保证我不是。
sentences.sourceTitle: 31 The Voice That Copied Andy · 模仿 Andy 声音的东西

sentences.english: Don't like the video. Don't comment if you don't want to.
sentences.chinese: 不想点赞就别点，不想评论就别评论。
sentences.sourceTitle: 31 The Voice That Copied Andy · 模仿 Andy 声音的东西

sentences.english: I just need somebody who knows what this is. Please reach out.
sentences.chinese: 我只是需要一个懂这是什么的人。请联系我。
sentences.sourceTitle: 31 The Voice That Copied Andy · 模仿 Andy 声音的东西

sentences.english: I don't care if it's in a comment or privately. Just please reach out, and please just help me.
sentences.chinese: 评论也好，私信也好，我都不在乎。请联系我，求你们帮帮我。
sentences.sourceTitle: 31 The Voice That Copied Andy · 模仿 Andy 声音的东西

sentences.english: I don't know what to tell my wife when she gets home.
sentences.chinese: 我不知道我妻子回家后该怎么跟她说。
sentences.sourceTitle: 31 The Voice That Copied Andy · 模仿 Andy 声音的东西

sentences.english: I can't afford a hotel for the night.
sentences.chinese: 我住不起酒店。
sentences.sourceTitle: 31 The Voice That Copied Andy · 模仿 Andy 声音的东西

sentences.english: We're doing a remodel in the bathroom, and everything's just going in right now.
sentences.chinese: 我们正在翻修浴室，现在什么都在弄。
sentences.sourceTitle: 31 The Voice That Copied Andy · 模仿 Andy 声音的东西

sentences.english: And I'm not trying to be dramatic about this, but I have no idea what to do.
sentences.chinese: 我不是故意夸张，但我真的不知道该怎么办。
sentences.sourceTitle: 31 The Voice That Copied Andy · 模仿 Andy 声音的东西

sentences.english: And everybody in the comments all day has just been freaking me out, and I want to think this is just in my head.
sentences.chinese: 评论区的人一整天都在吓我，我也想相信这只是我自己想多了。
sentences.sourceTitle: 31 The Voice That Copied Andy · 模仿 Andy 声音的东西

sentences.english: But I keep listening to it over and over and over again.
sentences.chinese: 但我一遍又一遍地反复听。
sentences.sourceTitle: 31 The Voice That Copied Andy · 模仿 Andy 声音的东西

sentences.english: Somebody please, somebody please reach out with an answer or some help or something.
sentences.chinese: 求求谁来给我一个答案，或者帮帮我，什么都行。
sentences.sourceTitle: 31 The Voice That Copied Andy · 模仿 Andy 声音的东西

sentences.english: As you can tell by the video, Andy is in total shock and cannot process the strange incident that took place inside his home.
sentences.chinese: 从视频可以看出，Andy 完全被吓坏了，无法接受家里发生的这件怪事。
sentences.sourceTitle: 31 The Voice That Copied Andy · 模仿 Andy 声音的东西

sentences.english: Luckily, he was able to record this incident in case no one believed him.
sentences.chinese: 幸好他把这件事录了下来，以防没人相信他。
sentences.sourceTitle: 31 The Voice That Copied Andy · 模仿 Andy 声音的东西

sentences.english: Andy writes, "I don't know what to do at this point.
sentences.chinese: Andy 写道：“现在我真的不知道该怎么办了。
sentences.sourceTitle: 31 The Voice That Copied Andy · 模仿 Andy 声音的东西

sentences.english: Things got weird last night, and I had to sleep in my car.
sentences.chinese: 昨晚事情变得很诡异，我只好睡在车里。
sentences.sourceTitle: 31 The Voice That Copied Andy · 模仿 Andy 声音的东西

sentences.english: I am safe, but I am not doing well, and I need help."
sentences.chinese: 我很安全，但状态很差，我需要帮助。”
sentences.sourceTitle: 31 The Voice That Copied Andy · 模仿 Andy 声音的东西

sentences.english: This is what he caught.
sentences.chinese: 这就是他拍到的。
sentences.sourceTitle: 31 The Voice That Copied Andy · 模仿 Andy 声音的东西

sentences.english: Hey, come here. Come here.
sentences.chinese: 嘿，过来。过来。
sentences.sourceTitle: 31 The Voice That Copied Andy · 模仿 Andy 声音的东西

sentences.english: Andy can rest assured that he's not losing his mind, as the video shows that someone or something is mimicking his own voice.
sentences.chinese: Andy 可以放心，他没有疯，因为视频显示，确实有人或某种东西在模仿他的声音。
sentences.sourceTitle: 31 The Voice That Copied Andy · 模仿 Andy 声音的东西

sentences.english: It's up to you to decide as to whether or not something supernatural was caught on camera.
sentences.chinese: 镜头是否拍到了超自然的东西，由你来决定。
sentences.sourceTitle: 31 The Voice That Copied Andy · 模仿 Andy 声音的东西

sentences.english: Andy is certain that he did.
sentences.chinese: Andy 确信他拍到了。
sentences.sourceTitle: 31 The Voice That Copied Andy · 模仿 Andy 声音的东西

sentences.english: But for now, the video remains a mystery and is left open to interpretation.
sentences.chinese: 但目前，这段视频仍然是个谜，任人解读。
sentences.sourceTitle: 31 The Voice That Copied Andy · 模仿 Andy 声音的东西

sentences.english: Laura Honeken posted the following video after capturing footage of something creepy on her baby monitor.
sentences.chinese: Laura Honeken 在婴儿监视器上拍到诡异的画面后，发布了下面这段视频。
sentences.sourceTitle: 32 Legs on the Baby Monitor · 婴儿监视器里的腿

sentences.english: Her daughter is resting in her crib when Laura all of a sudden gets a bad feeling.
sentences.chinese: 她女儿正在婴儿床里休息，Laura 突然有种不好的预感。
sentences.sourceTitle: 32 Legs on the Baby Monitor · 婴儿监视器里的腿

sentences.english: She promptly runs to her daughter's room and sees that she's okay.
sentences.chinese: 她立刻跑到女儿房间，看到女儿没事。
sentences.sourceTitle: 32 Legs on the Baby Monitor · 婴儿监视器里的腿

sentences.english: But little does she know that something was captured on her baby monitor before she had entered the room.
sentences.chinese: 但她不知道，在她进房间之前，婴儿监视器已经拍到了什么。
sentences.sourceTitle: 32 Legs on the Baby Monitor · 婴儿监视器里的腿

sentences.english: It's worth mentioning that no one was upstairs at the time of this recording.
sentences.chinese: 值得一提的是，拍摄时楼上没有任何人。
sentences.sourceTitle: 32 Legs on the Baby Monitor · 婴儿监视器里的腿

sentences.english: Laura writes, "I'm terrified."
sentences.chinese: Laura 写道：“我吓坏了。”
sentences.sourceTitle: 32 Legs on the Baby Monitor · 婴儿监视器里的腿

sentences.english: This is what was caught.
sentences.chinese: 这就是拍到的画面。
sentences.sourceTitle: 32 Legs on the Baby Monitor · 婴儿监视器里的腿

sentences.english: It appears that a pair of legs were caught on camera.
sentences.chinese: 镜头里好像拍到了一双腿。
sentences.sourceTitle: 32 Legs on the Baby Monitor · 婴儿监视器里的腿

sentences.english: Here's a follow-up video Laura had made in response to this creepy footage.
sentences.chinese: 这是 Laura 针对这段诡异画面拍的后续视频。
sentences.sourceTitle: 32 Legs on the Baby Monitor · 婴儿监视器里的腿

sentences.english: There was legs that were walking. It looked like legs that were walking out of her room.
sentences.chinese: 有腿在走。看起来像是一双腿从她房间里走出来。
sentences.sourceTitle: 32 Legs on the Baby Monitor · 婴儿监视器里的腿

sentences.english: And her window is locked. There's no other entrance to that room, literally.
sentences.chinese: 而且她的窗户是锁着的。那个房间真的没有别的入口。
sentences.sourceTitle: 32 Legs on the Baby Monitor · 婴儿监视器里的腿

sentences.english: And you've never seen nothing going in. It just was legs going out.
sentences.chinese: 你也从来没看到有东西进去，只看到腿走出来。
sentences.sourceTitle: 32 Legs on the Baby Monitor · 婴儿监视器里的腿

sentences.english: You see me come in, come out, and then you see those legs go out, and then you see me come upstairs to get her and go out.
sentences.chinese: 你能看到我进来、出去，然后看到那双腿走出去，再然后看到我上楼把她抱出去。
sentences.sourceTitle: 32 Legs on the Baby Monitor · 婴儿监视器里的腿

sentences.english: Laura doesn't know what to make of this.
sentences.chinese: Laura 不知道该怎么解释这件事。
sentences.sourceTitle: 32 Legs on the Baby Monitor · 婴儿监视器里的腿

sentences.english: What's strange about this is that whoever or whatever this was appears to have come out of nowhere, as no signs of entry were seen in the daughter's room.
sentences.chinese: 奇怪的是，不管这是谁或是什么，它好像是凭空出现的，因为女儿的房间里没有任何进入的迹象。
sentences.sourceTitle: 32 Legs on the Baby Monitor · 婴儿监视器里的腿

sentences.english: It could be that a squatter was hiding in the house, given the fact that most squatters tend to hide in places like the attic.
sentences.chinese: 也可能是有人偷偷藏在房子里，毕竟这种人大多喜欢躲在阁楼之类的地方。
sentences.sourceTitle: 32 Legs on the Baby Monitor · 婴儿监视器里的腿

sentences.english: Perhaps that's where they came from.
sentences.chinese: 也许它就是从那里来的。
sentences.sourceTitle: 32 Legs on the Baby Monitor · 婴儿监视器里的腿

sentences.english: But of course, I'll leave it to you to figure this one out.
sentences.chinese: 当然，这件事就交给你来琢磨了。
sentences.sourceTitle: 32 Legs on the Baby Monitor · 婴儿监视器里的腿

sentences.english: Was a ghost caught on camera, or had something else been captured?
sentences.chinese: 是镜头拍到了鬼，还是拍到了别的东西？
sentences.sourceTitle: 32 Legs on the Baby Monitor · 婴儿监视器里的腿

sentences.english: Rewatch the clip and decide for yourself.
sentences.chinese: 重看一遍片段，自己判断吧。
sentences.sourceTitle: 32 Legs on the Baby Monitor · 婴儿监视器里的腿

sentences.english: The following footage shows someone who's by himself inside a gym when something terrifying happens.
sentences.chinese: 下面这段画面里，一个人独自在健身房，这时发生了可怕的事。
sentences.sourceTitle: 33 The Gym · 健身房里的拖拽

sentences.english: Emily Ruiz, who suggested the video, writes, "Words cannot explain this disturbing footage."
sentences.chinese: 推荐这段视频的 Emily Ruiz 写道：“这段令人不安的画面，简直无法用语言形容。”
sentences.sourceTitle: 33 The Gym · 健身房里的拖拽

sentences.english: The person in the video had obtained this recording from the gym and sent it to a friend, who we hear speaking in the video.
sentences.chinese: 视频里的这个人从健身房拿到了这段录像，发给了一个朋友，我们在视频里听到的就是那位朋友在说话。
sentences.sourceTitle: 33 The Gym · 健身房里的拖拽

sentences.english: This is what was captured.
sentences.chinese: 这就是拍到的画面。
sentences.sourceTitle: 33 The Gym · 健身房里的拖拽

sentences.english: Those who've seen the footage were left unsettled by this terrifying encounter.
sentences.chinese: 看过这段画面的人都被这次可怕的遭遇弄得心神不宁。
sentences.sourceTitle: 33 The Gym · 健身房里的拖拽

sentences.english: At the start of the video, we can see that someone or something is peeking at this person.
sentences.chinese: 在视频开头，我们能看到有人或某种东西在偷看这个人。
sentences.sourceTitle: 33 The Gym · 健身房里的拖拽

sentences.english: This is something you might have missed.
sentences.chinese: 这一点你可能没注意到。
sentences.sourceTitle: 33 The Gym · 健身房里的拖拽

sentences.english: Now, it's worth mentioning that another camera had recorded this from a different angle.
sentences.chinese: 值得一提的是，另一台摄像头从另一个角度也拍下了这一幕。
sentences.sourceTitle: 33 The Gym · 健身房里的拖拽

sentences.english: By looking at this specific footage, we can see that the facility has open windows.
sentences.chinese: 从这段画面可以看到，这个场馆的窗户是开着的。
sentences.sourceTitle: 33 The Gym · 健身房里的拖拽

sentences.english: It could be that the wind from outside the room was causing the ropes to move on their own.
sentences.chinese: 可能是外面吹进来的风让绳子自己动了起来。
sentences.sourceTitle: 33 The Gym · 健身房里的拖拽
