sentences.english: But if that were the case, then other things in the room should have moved as well, especially the towel on the box, which appears light enough to move just a bit, but it doesn't.
sentences.chinese: 但如果是这样，房间里的其他东西也应该会动，尤其是箱子上的毛巾，它看起来很轻，应该会动一点，但它没动。
sentences.sourceTitle: 33 The Gym · 健身房里的拖拽

sentences.english: The wind could also explain the ball's movement, but mind you, this is a medicine ball.
sentences.chinese: 风也可以解释球的移动，但请注意，这可是个药球。
sentences.sourceTitle: 33 The Gym · 健身房里的拖拽

sentences.english: It would take more than just a gust of wind to be able to move something this heavy.
sentences.chinese: 要移动这么重的东西，光靠一阵风是不够的。
sentences.sourceTitle: 33 The Gym · 健身房里的拖拽

sentences.english: But what's even more baffling about this footage is how the person gets dragged across the floor.
sentences.chinese: 但这段画面更令人费解的是，这个人被拖着划过了地面。
sentences.sourceTitle: 33 The Gym · 健身房里的拖拽

sentences.english: It could be that he was doing this on his own, moving his body in such a way to make it seem as though he were being dragged.
sentences.chinese: 也可能是他自己在动，用某种方式移动身体，让人看起来像是被拖走的。
sentences.sourceTitle: 33 The Gym · 健身房里的拖拽

sentences.english: However, a closer look at the scene shows that he was jerked in a forceful manner, which is almost impossible to do on one's own.
sentences.chinese: 然而仔细看画面会发现，他是被猛地一拽，这几乎不可能是自己做到的。
sentences.sourceTitle: 33 The Gym · 健身房里的拖拽

sentences.english: Other things in the video remain questionable, such as lights turning off on their own, or whatever this is.
sentences.chinese: 视频里还有其他可疑之处，比如灯自己熄灭，还有这个不知道是什么的东西。
sentences.sourceTitle: 33 The Gym · 健身房里的拖拽

sentences.english: I'll leave it to you to come up with your own conclusion on this footage.
sentences.chinese: 对这段画面，就由你自己得出结论吧。
sentences.sourceTitle: 33 The Gym · 健身房里的拖拽

sentences.english: Feel free to let me know what you think.
sentences.chinese: 欢迎告诉我你的看法。
sentences.sourceTitle: 33 The Gym · 健身房里的拖拽

sentences.english: Katrina Pariso had taken a photo of herself while being at home with no one else around.
sentences.chinese: Katrina Pariso 在家里没有别人时，给自己拍了张照片。
sentences.sourceTitle: 34 The Selfie · 自拍里的身影

sentences.english: She had the house to herself, or so she thought.
sentences.chinese: 她以为家里只有她一个人。
sentences.sourceTitle: 34 The Selfie · 自拍里的身影

sentences.english: It was after having taken a selfie that she realized that she wasn't alone.
sentences.chinese: 拍完自拍后，她才发现自己并不是一个人。
sentences.sourceTitle: 34 The Selfie · 自拍里的身影

sentences.english: This is the photo she took.
sentences.chinese: 这就是她拍的照片。
sentences.sourceTitle: 34 The Selfie · 自拍里的身影

sentences.english: Now, at first glance, nothing unusual stands out, that is, until you brighten up the image and see that someone is behind her.
sentences.chinese: 乍一看没有什么异常，直到你把照片调亮，才看到她身后有一个人。
sentences.sourceTitle: 34 The Selfie · 自拍里的身影

sentences.english: Katrina swears that she was home alone when she took this, but apparently, she wasn't.
sentences.chinese: Katrina 发誓拍照时家里只有她一个人，但显然并不是。
sentences.sourceTitle: 34 The Selfie · 自拍里的身影

sentences.english: Katrina believes that a ghost had photobombed her picture, and she also thinks that this may have been her brother, who had passed away years ago.
sentences.chinese: Katrina 认为是有个鬼闯进了她的照片，她还觉得那可能是她多年前去世的兄弟。
sentences.sourceTitle: 34 The Selfie · 自拍里的身影

sentences.english: She isn't sure if that's him, though, as it appears to have long hair, which he didn't have.
sentences.chinese: 不过她不确定是不是他，因为照片里的人好像是长发，而他没有长发。
sentences.sourceTitle: 34 The Selfie · 自拍里的身影

sentences.english: She has yet to figure out what this might have been, but one thing's for sure, though: this photo has left Katrina spooked and still keeps her up at night.
sentences.chinese: 她还没弄清楚这到底是什么，但有一点可以肯定：这张照片把 Katrina 吓坏了，至今还让她夜里睡不着。
sentences.sourceTitle: 34 The Selfie · 自拍里的身影

sentences.english: Thanks for watching, and I hope you enjoyed.
sentences.chinese: 感谢收看，希望你喜欢。
sentences.sourceTitle: 34 The Selfie · 自拍里的身影

sentences.english: Happy holidays, and take care.
sentences.chinese: 节日快乐，保重。
sentences.sourceTitle: 34 The Selfie · 自拍里的身影
